View details What is the Privacy Policy and what does it cover? Effective July 23, 2026 | View printable version | See previous versions Highlights We at Meta want you to understand what information we collect, and how we use and share it. That’s why we encourage you to read our Privacy Policy. This helps you use Meta Products in the way that’s right for you. In the Privacy Policy, we explain how we collect, use, share, retain and transfer information. We also let you know your rights. Each section of this Policy includes helpful examples and simpler language to make our practices easier to understand. We’ve also added links to resources where you can learn more about the privacy topics that interest you. It's important to us that you know how to control your privacy, so we also show you where you can manage your information in the settings of the Meta Products you use. You can update these settings to shape your experience. Read the full Policy below. What Products does this Policy cover? Learn more in Privacy Center about managing your privacy What information do we collect? Highlights The information we collect and process about you depends on how you use our Products . For example, we collect different information if you sell furniture on Marketplace than if you ask Meta AI to write a joke for you. When you use our Products, we collect some information about you even if you don't have an account . Here's the information we collect: Your activity and information you provide Friends, followers and other connections App, browser and device information Information from partners, vendors and other third parties What if you don’t let us collect certain information? Some information is required for our Products to work. Other information is optional, but without it, the quality of your experience might be affected. Learn more What if the information we collect doesn’t identify individuals? In some cases information is de-identified, aggregated, or anonymized by third parties so that it no longer identifies individuals before it’s made available to us. We use this information as described below without trying to re-identify individuals. Take control Manage the information we collect about you Privacy Center How do we use your information? Highlights We use information we collect to provide a personalized experience to you, including ads, along with the other purposes we explain in detail below. For some of these purposes, we use information across our Products and across your devices . The information we use for these purposes is automatically processed by our systems. But in some cases, we also use manual review to access and review your information. To use less information that’s connected to individual users, in some cases we de-identify or aggregate information or anonymize it so that it no longer identifies you. We use this information in the same ways we use your information as described in this section. Here are the ways we use your information: To provide, personalize and improve our Products We use information we have to provide and improve our Products . This includes: Seeing if our Products are working correctly, such as troubleshooting, and fixing it when it’s not working Personalizing features, content and recommendations , such as your Facebook Feed , Instagram Feed , Meta AI, Stories and ads. We use information with special protections you choose to provide for these purposes, but not to show you ads. Read more about how we use information to provide, personalize and improve our Products: How we show ads and other sponsored or commercial content How we use information to improve Meta Products How we use information to personalize our features that are part of AI at Meta How we use location-related information To promote safety, security and integrity We use information we collect to help protect people from harm and provide safe, secure Products. Learn more To provide measurement, analytics and business services Lots of people rely on our Products to run or promote their businesses or share content. We help them measure how well their ads and other content, products and services are working. Learn more To communicate with you We communicate with you using information you've given us, like contact information you've entered on your profile. Learn more To research and innovate for social good We use information we have, information from researchers and datasets from publicly available sources, professional groups and non-profit groups to conduct and support research. Learn more More in the Privacy Policy Why and how we process your information How is your information shared on Meta Products or with integrated partners? Highlights On Meta Products Learn more about the different cases when your information can be shared on our Products : People and accounts you share and communicate with Content others share or reshare about you Public content With integrated partners You can choose to connect with integrated partners who use our Products. If you do, these integrated partners receive information about you and your activity. These integrated partners can always access information that’s public on our Products. Learn more about other information they receive and how they handle your information: When you use an integrated partner’s product or service When you interact with someone else’s content on an integrated partner’s product or service How integrated partners handle your information Take control Learn more about audiences Privacy Center Manage apps and websites How do we share information with third parties? Highlights We don't sell any of your information to anyone, and we never will. We also require partners and other third parties to follow rules about how they can and cannot use and disclose the information we provide. Here’s more detail about who we share information with: Partners Advertisers and Audience Network publishers Partners who use our analytics services Partners who offer goods or services on our Products and commerce services platforms Integrated partners Vendors Measurement vendors Marketing vendors Service providers Service providers Third parties External researchers AI integrations Other third parties We also share information with other third parties in response to legal requests, to comply with applicable law or to prevent harm. Read the Policy . And if we sell or transfer all or part of our business to someone else, in some cases we’ll give the new owner your information as part of that transaction, but only as the law allows. How do the Meta Companies work together? Highlights We are part of the Meta Companies that provide Meta Company Products. Meta Company Products include all the Meta Products covered by this Policy, plus other products like WhatsApp and more. We share information we collect, infrastructure, systems and technology with the other Meta Companies. Learn more about how we transfer information to other countries. We also process information that we receive about you from other Meta Companies, according to their terms and policies and as permitted by applicable law. In some cases, Meta acts as a service provider for other Meta Companies. We act on their behalf and in accordance with their instructions and terms. Why we share across the Meta Companies Meta Products share information with other Meta Companies: To promote safety, security and integrity and comply with applicable laws To personalize offers, ads and other sponsored or commercial content To develop, provide and personalize features and integrations To understand how people use and interact with Meta Company Products See some examples of why we share. More resources Review the privacy policies of the other Meta Companies Facebook Help Center How can you manage or delete your information and exercise your rights? Highlights We offer you a variety of tools to view, manage, download and delete your information below. You can also manage your information by visiting the settings of the Products you use. You may also have other privacy rights under applicable laws. To exercise your rights, visit our Help Centers, your settings for Facebook and Instagram and your device-based settings. Take a privacy checkup Take a privacy checkup Be guided through Facebook privacy settings View and manage your information Access your information Your information and permissions Ad preferences Manage your data Port, download or delete your information Port your information Download your information Delete your information or account You can learn more about how privacy works on Facebook and on Instagram , and in the Facebook Help Center . If you have questions about this policy, you can contact us as described below. In some countries, you may also be able to contact the Data Protection Officer for Meta Platforms, Inc., and depending on your jurisdiction, you may also contact your local Data Protection Authority (“DPA”) directly. How long do we keep your information? Highlights We keep information as long as we need it to provide our Products, comply with legal obligations or protect our or other’s interests. We decide how long we need information on a case-by-case basis. Here’s what we consider when we decide: If we need it to operate or provide our Products. For example, we need to keep some of your information to maintain your account. Learn more . The feature we use it for, and how that feature works. For example, messages sent using Messenger’s vanish mode are retained for less time than regular messages. Learn more . How long we need to retain the information to comply with certain legal obligations. See some examples . If we need it for other legitimate purposes, such as to prevent harm; investigate possible violations of our terms or policies; promote safety, security and integrity; or protect ourselves, including our rights, property or products In some instances and for specific reasons, we’ll keep information for an extended period of time. Read our Policy about when we may preserve your information. How do we transfer information? Highlights Why is information transferred to other countries? Where is information transferred? How do we safeguard your information? How do we respond to legal requests, comply with applicable law and prevent harm? Highlights We access, preserve, use and share your information: In response to legal requests, like search warrants, court orders, production orders or subpoenas. These requests come from third parties such as civil litigants, law enforcement and other government authorities. Learn more about when we respond to legal requests. In accordance with applicable law To promote the safety, security and integrity of Meta Products , users, employees, property and the public. Learn more . We may access or preserve your information for an extended amount of time. Learn more . How will you know the Policy has changed? We'll notify you before we make material changes to this Policy. You’ll have the opportunity to review the revised Policy before you choose to continue using our Products. If you have questions about this Policy or have questions, complaints or requests regarding your information, you can contact us as described below. You can contact us online or by mail at: Meta Platforms, Inc. ATTN: Privacy Operations 1 Meta Way Menlo Park, CA 94025 Why and how we process your information The categories of information we use, and why and how information is processed, are set out below: Personalizing Meta Products Why and how we process your information: Our systems automatically process information we've collected and stored associated with you and others to assess and understand your interests and your preferences and provide you personalized experiences on and across the Meta Company Products in accordance with our terms. Our ads system prioritizes what ad to show you based on what audience advertisers want to reach. Then we match the ad to people who might be interested. Learn more about how our ads system works. text: ຂໍ້ກຳນົດບໍລິການ ເງື່ອນໄຂການໃຫ້ບໍລິການ ຂໍ້ກຳນົດບໍລິການຂອງບໍລິການແບບເສຍເງິນ ເງື່ອນໄຂການນຳໃຊ້ບໍລິການແບບເສຍເງິນ ກໍາລັງ​ເກັບ​ເອົາ​ແຈ້ງ​ການ​ຂອງ​ສະມາຄົມ ແຈ້ງການລິຂະສິດ ຄູ່​ມື​ຂໍ້ແນະ​ນໍາ​ຊຸມ​ຊົນ ຂໍ້ກຳນົດບໍລິການ ເບິ່ງຂໍ້ກຳນົດບໍລິການໃນພາສາອື່ນໆ: հայերեն , ខ្មែរ , فارسی , ລາວ , Hmong , ium , Filipino , العربية , 中文（中国） , 中文（台灣） , हिन्दी , 日本語 , 한국어 , ਪੰਜਾਬੀ , Русский , Español (Latinoamérica) , ไทย , Українська , Tiếng Việt , English ມີຫຍັງໃນຂໍ້ກໍານົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້? ດັດຊະນີນີ້ແມ່ນຖືກອອກແບບມາເພື່ອຊ່ວຍໃຫ້ທ່ານເຂົ້າໃຈບາງອັບເດດທີ່ສໍາຄັນທີ່ພວກເຮົາໄດ້ເຮັດໃນຂໍ້ກຳນົດການບໍລິການ (ຂໍ້ກໍານົດ) ຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ພວກເຮົາຫວັງວ່າສິ່ງນີ້ຈະເປັນຄຳແນະນໍາທີ່ເປັນປະໂຫຍດ, ແຕ່ກະລຸນາກວດໃຫ້ແນ່ໃຈວ່າທ່ານໄດ້ອ່ານຂໍ້ກໍານົດທັງໝົດແລ້ວ. ຍິນດີຕ້ອນຮັບສູ່ YouTube! ພາກສ່ວນນີ້ອະທິບາຍກ່ຽວກັບຄວາມສໍາພັນຂອງພວກເຮົາກັບທ່ານ. ມັນຮວມເອົາລາຍລະອຽດຂອງການບໍລິການ, ກໍານົດຂໍ້ຕົກລົງຂອງພວກເຮົາ ແລະ ລະບຸຊື່ຜູ້ໃຫ້ບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ. ໃຜສາມາດໃຊ້ບໍລິການໄດ້ແນ່? ພາກສ່ວນນີ້ກໍານົດບາງຂໍ້ກຳນົດສໍາລັບການນໍາໃຊ້ບໍລິການ ແລະ ກໍານົດໝວດໝູ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້. ການນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ ພາກສ່ວນນີ້ອະທິບາຍກ່ຽວກັບສິດຂອງທ່ານໃນການນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການ ແລະ ເງື່ອນໄຂທີ່ມີຜົນຕໍ່ການນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ. ມັນຍັງອະທິບາຍກ່ຽວກັບວິທີທີ່ພວກເຮົາອາດຈະປ່ຽນແປງການບໍລິການ. ເນື້ອຫາ ແລະ ການປະຕິບັດຂອງທ່ານ ພາກສ່ວນນີ້ມີຜົນກັບຜູ້ໃຊ້ທີ່ສະໜອງເນື້ອຫາໃຫ້ການບໍລິການ. ມັນກໍານົດຂອບເຂດຂອງການອະນຸຍາດທີ່ທ່ານມອບໃຫ້ໂດຍການອັບໂຫຼດເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານ ແລະ ຮວມເອົາການຕົກລົງຂອງທ່ານທີ່ຈະບໍ່ອັບໂຫຼດສິ່ງທີ່ລະເມີດສິດຂອງຄົນອື່ນ. ການລະງັບ ແລະ ການປິດບັນຊີ ພາກສ່ວນນີ້ອະທິບາຍກ່ຽວກັບວິທີທີ່ທ່ານ ແລະ YouTube ອາດຈະຍົກເລີກຄວາມສໍາພັນນີ້. ກ່ຽວກັບຊອບແວໃນການບໍລິການ ພາກສ່ວນນີ້ຮວມເອົາລາຍລະອຽດກ່ຽວກັບຊອບແວໃນການບໍລິການ. ຂໍ້ກໍານົດທາງກົດໝາຍອື່ນໆ ພາກສ່ວນນີ້ຮວມເອົາຄວາມມຸ່ງໝັ້ນໃນການບໍລິການຂອງພວກເຮົາທີ່ມີຕໍ່ທ່ານ. ມັນຍັງອະທິບາຍວ່າມີບາງສິ່ງທີ່ພວກເຮົາຈະບໍ່ຮັບຜິດຊອບ. ກ່ຽວກັບຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ພາກສ່ວນນີ້ຮວມເອົາລາຍລະອຽດທີ່ສໍາຄັນເພີ່ມເຕີມກ່ຽວກັບສັນຍາຂອງພວກເຮົາ, ເຊິ່ງຮວມມີສິ່ງທີ່ຄວນຄາດຫວັງຫາກພວກເຮົາຕ້ອງການປ່ຽນແປງຂໍ້ກໍານົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້ ຫຼື ກົດໝາຍໃດທີ່ມີຜົນກັບຂໍ້ກຳນົດດັ່ງກ່າວ. ຂໍ້ກຳນົດບໍລິການ ວັນ​ທີ: 15 ທັນວາ 2023 ຂໍ້ກຳນົດບໍລິການ ຍິນດີຕ້ອນຮັບສູ່ YouTube! ພາກແນະນໍາ ຂອບໃຈທີ່ໃຊ້ແພລດຟອມ YouTube ແລະ ຜະລິດຕະພັນ, ບໍລິການ ແລະ ຄຸນສົມບັດທີ່ພວກເຮົາສະໜອງໃຫ້ເປັນສ່ວນໜຶ່ງຂອງແພລດຟອມແກ່ທ່ານ (ເອີ້ນຮວມກັນວ່າ “ບໍລິການ”). ການ ບໍລິການຂອງພວກເຮົາ ບໍລິການອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ທ່ານຄົ້ນພົບ, ເບິ່ງ ແລະ ແບ່ງປັນວິດີໂອ ແລະ ເນື້ອຫາອື່ນໆ, ສະໜອງກະທູ້ເພື່ອໃຫ້ຄົນເຊື່ອມຕໍ່, ແຈ້ງ ແລະ ສ້າງແຮງບັນດານໃຈໃຫ້ຜູ້ອື່ນໆທົ່ວໂລກ ແລະ ດໍາເນີນການເປັນແພລດຟອມເຜີຍແຜ່ສໍາລັບຜູ້ສ້າງເນື້ອຫາຕົ້ນສະບັບ ແລະ ຜູ້ລົງໂຄສະນາຂະໜາດໃຫຍ່ ແລະ ນ້ອຍ. ພວກເຮົາສະໜອງຂໍ້ມູນຈໍານວນຫຼາຍກ່ຽວກັບຜະລິດຕະພັນຂອງພວກເຮົາ ແລະ ວິທີທີ່ພວກເຮົານໍາໃຊ້ພວກມັນໃນ ສູນຊ່ວຍເຫຼືອ ຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ພ້ອມກັນນັ້ນ, ທ່ານຍັງສາມາດຊອກຮູ້ກ່ຽວກັບ YouTube Kids , ໂຄງການຮຸ້ນສ່ວນ YouTube ແລະ ການເປັນສະມາຊິກແບບເສຍເງິນ ແລະ ການຊື້ໃນ YouTube (ໃນບ່ອນທີ່ໃຊ້ໄດ້). ທ່ານຍັງສາມາດອ່ານເນື້ອຫາທີ່ມ່ວນທັງໝົດໃນ ອຸປະກອນອື່ນ ເຊັ່ນ : ໂທລະທັດຂອງທ່ານ , ເຄື່ອງຫຼິ້ນເກມຂອງທ່ານ ຫຼື Google Home . ຜູ້ໃຫ້ບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ ນິຕິບຸກຄົນທີ່ສະໜອງບໍລິການແມ່ນ Google LLC, ເຊິ່ງເປັນບໍລິສັດທີ່ດໍາເນີນການພາຍໃຕ້ກົດໝາຍຂອງເດລາແວ, ທີ່ຕັ້ງຢູ່ 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043 (ເອີ້ນວ່າ “ YouTube ”, “ ພວກເຮົາ ”, “ ເຮົາ ” ຫຼື “ ຂອງພວກເຮົາ ”). ການອ້າງອີງເຖິງ “ບໍລິສັດໃນເຄືອ” ຂອງ YouTube ໃນຂໍ້ກໍານົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້ໝາຍເຖິງບໍລິສັດອື່ນໆພາຍໃນກຸ່ມບໍລິສັດ Alphabet Inc. (ໃນຕອນນີ້ ຫຼື ໃນອະນາຄົດ). ຂໍ້ກຳນົດທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ ການໃຊ້ບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານແມ່ນຢູ່ພາຍໃຕ້ຂໍ້ກຳນົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້, ຮວມທັງ ຂໍ້ແນະນຳຊຸມຊົນ YouTube ແລະ ນະໂຍບາຍ , ຄວາມປອດໄພ ແລະ ນະໂຍບາຍລິຂະສິດ ເຊິ່ງອາດມີການປັບປຸງເປັນບາງໄລຍະ (ໂດຍເອີ້ນຮວມກັນວ່າ " ຂໍ້ຕົກລົງ " ນີ້). ນອກຈາກນັ້ນ, ຂໍ້ຕົກລົງຂອງທ່ານກັບພວກເຮົາຍັງຮວມມີ ນະໂຍບາຍການໂຄສະນາຢູ່ YouTube ນຳ ຫາກທ່ານໂຄສະນາ ຫຼື ເປັນຜູ້ສະໜັບສະໜູນໃນບໍລິການ ຫຼື ມີການໂປຣໂໝດແບບເສຍເງິນຮວມຢູ່ໃນເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານ. ລິ້ງ ຫຼື ຂໍ້ມູນອ້າງອີງອື່ນໆໃດໆທີ່ລະບຸໄວ້ໃນຂໍ້ກຳນົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້ແມ່ນມີໄວ້ເພື່ອໃຫ້ຂໍ້ມູນເທົ່ານັ້ນ ແລະ ບໍ່ໄດ້ເປັນສ່ວນໜຶ່ງຂອງຂໍ້ຕົກລົງ. ກະລຸນາອ່ານຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ໃຫ້ລະອຽດແລ້ວກວດໃຫ້ແນ່ໃຈວ່າທ່ານເຂົ້າໃຈມັນ. ຫາກທ່ານບໍ່ເຂົ້າໃຈຂໍ້ຕົກລົງ ຫຼື ບໍ່ຍອມຮັບພາກສ່ວນໃດໜຶ່ງຂອງມັນ, ທ່ານຈະບໍ່ສາມາດໃຊ້ບໍລິການໄດ້. ໃຜສາມາດໃຊ້ການບໍລິການໄດ້ແດ່? ຂໍ້ກຳນົດທາງດ້ານອາຍຸ ທ່ານຕ້ອງມີອາຍຸ 13 ປີຂຶ້ນໄປເພື່ອໃຊ້ການບໍລິການ; ຢ່າງໃດກໍຕາມ, ເດັກນ້ອຍທຸກກຸ່ມອາຍຸສາມາດໃຊ້ການບໍລິການ ແລະ YouTube Kids (ໃນບ່ອນທີ່ໃຊ້ໄດ້) ຖ້າພໍ່ແມ່ ຫຼື ຜູ້ປົກຄອງຕາມກົດໝາຍເປີດການນຳໃຊ້ແລ້ວ. ການອະນຸຍາດໂດຍພໍ່ແມ່ ຫຼື ຜູ້ປົກຄອງ ຫາກທ່ານມີອາຍຸຕ່ຳກວ່າ 18 ປີ, ທ່ານຮັບຮອງວ່າທ່ານໄດ້ຮັບ ການອະນຸຍາດຈາກພໍ່ແມ່ ຫຼື ຜູ້ປົກຄອງຂອງທ່ານໃຫ້ໃຊ້ບໍລິການນີ້. ກະລຸນາຂໍໃຫ້ພວກເພິ່ນອ່ານຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ຮ່ວມກັບທ່ານ. ຫາກທ່ານເປັນພໍ່ແມ່ ຫຼື ຜູ້ປົກຄອງຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້ທີ່ມີອາຍຸຕ່ຳກວ່າ 18 ປີ, ໂດຍການອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ລູກຂອງທ່ານໃຊ້ການບໍລິການ, ແມ່ນທ່ານຢູ່ພາຍໃຕ້ຂໍ້ກຳນົດຂອງຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ແລະ ຮັບຜິດຊອບຕໍ່ການເຄື່ອນໄຫວຂອງລູກທ່ານໃນການບໍລິການດັ່ງກ່າວ. ທ່ານສາມາດຊອກຫາເຄື່ອງມື ແລະ ແຫຼ່ງຂໍ້ມູນເພື່ອຊ່ວຍທ່ານຈັດການປະສົບການໃນການນຳໃຊ້ YouTube ຂອງຄອບຄົວທ່ານ (ຮວມທັງວິທີເປີດໃຊ້ບໍລິການ ແລະ YouTube Kids ສຳລັບເດັກນ້ອຍອາຍຸຕ່ຳກວ່າ 13 ປີ) ໄດ້ໃນ ສູນຊ່ວຍເຫຼືອ ຂອງພວກເຮົາ ແລະ ຜ່ານ Family Link ຂອງ Google . Businesses ຖ້າຫາກທ່ານກໍາລັງໃຊ້ການບໍລິການໃນນາມຂອງບໍລິສັດ ຫຼື ອົງກອນ, ທ່ານສະແດງຕົວວ່າທ່ານມີສິດດໍາເນີນການໃນນາມຂອງນິຕິບຸກຄົນນັ້ນ ແລະ ນິຕິບຸກຄົນດັ່ງກ່າວຍອມຮັບຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້. ການນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ ເນື້ອຫາກ່ຽວກັບການບໍລິການ ເນື້ອຫາກ່ຽວກັບການບໍລິການແມ່ນຮວມມີວິດີໂອ, ສຽງ (ຕົວຢ່າງ: ເພງ ແລະ ສຽງອື່ນໆ), ຮູບພາບກຣາບຟິກ, ຮູບພາບ, ຂໍ້ຄວາມ (ເຊັ່ນ: ຄຳເຫັນ ແລະ ສະຄຣິບ), ຍີ່ຫໍ້ (ຮວມມີຊື່ການຄ້າ, ເຄື່ອງໝາຍການຄ້າ, ເຄື່ອງໝາຍການບໍລິການ ຫຼື ໂລໂກ້), ຄຸນສົມບັດຄວາມສາມາດໃນການໂຕ້ຕອບ, ຊອບແວ, ການວັດແທກ ແລະ ລາຍການອື່ນໆທີ່ສະໜອງໂດຍທ່ານ, YouTube ຫຼື ພາກສ່ວນທີສາມ (ເອີ້ນຮວມກັນວ່າ "ເນື້ອຫາ”). ເນື້ອຫາແມ່ນຄວາມຮັບຜິດຊອບຂອງບຸກຄົນ ຫຼື ນິຕິບຸກຄົນທີ່ສະໜອງເນື້ອຫາໃຫ້ການບໍລິການ. YouTube ບໍ່ມີພັນທະທີ່ຈະໂຮສ ຫຼື ສະແດງເນື້ອຫາ. ຖ້າຫາກທ່ານເຫັນເນື້ອຫາໃດໆທີ່ທ່ານເຊື່ອວ່າບໍ່ປະຕິບັດຕາມຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້, ຮວມທັງການລະເມີດ ຂໍ້ແນະນຳຊຸມຊົນ ຫຼື ກົດໝາຍ, ທ່ານສາມາດ ລາຍງານມັນໃຫ້ພວກເຮົາໄດ້ . ບັນຊີ Google ແລະ ຊ່ອງ YouTube ທ່ານສາມາດໃຊ້ພາກສ່ວນຕ່າງໆຂອງບໍລິການໄດ້, ເຊັ່ນ: ການເລືອກເບິ່ງ ແລະ ການຊອກຫາເນື້ອຫາໂດຍທີ່ບໍ່ມີ ບັນຊີ Google . ຢ່າງໃດກໍຕາມ, ທ່ານຈໍາເປັນຕ້ອງມີບັນຊີ Google ເພື່ອໃຊ້ບາງຄຸນສົມບັດ. ດ້ວຍບັນຊີ Google, ທ່ານຈະສາມາດຖືກໃຈວິດີໂອ, ຕິດຕາມຊ່ອງ, ສ້າງຊ່ອງ YouTube ຂອງທ່ານເອງ ແລະ ອື່ນໆອີກ. ທ່ານສາມາດປະຕິບັດຕາມຄຳແນະນຳເຫຼົ່ານີ້ເພື່ອ ສ້າງບັນຊີ Google . ການສ້າງຊ່ອງ YouTube ຈະເຮັດໃຫ້ທ່ານເຂົ້າເຖິງຄຸນສົມບັດ ແລະ ຟັງຊັນເພີ່ມເຕີມ, ເຊັ່ນ: ການອັບໂຫຼດວິດີໂອ, ການສະແດງຄໍາເຫັນ ຫຼື ການສ້າງລາຍການຫຼິ້ນ (ໃນບ່ອນທີ່ໃຊ້ໄດ້). ນີ້ແມ່ນລາຍລະອຽດຈໍານວນໜຶ່ງກ່ຽວກັບວິທີ ສ້າງຊ່ອງ YouTube ຂອງທ່ານເອງ . ເພື່ອປົກປ້ອງບັນຊີ Google ຂອງທ່ານ, ໃຫ້ຮັກສາລະຫັດຜ່ານຂອງທ່ານເປັນຄວາມລັບ. ທ່ານບໍ່ຄວນໃຊ້ລະຫັດຜ່ານບັນຊີ Google ຊ້ຳໃນແອັບພລິເຄຊັນຂອງບຸກຄົນທີສາມ. ສຶກສາເພີ່ມເຕີມກ່ຽວກັບ ການຮັກສາບັນຊີ Google ຂອງທ່ານໃຫ້ປອດໄພ , ຮວມທັງສິ່ງທີ່ຕ້ອງເຮັດຫາກທ່ານຮູ້ວ່າມີການໃຊ້ລະຫັດຜ່ານ ຫຼື ບັນຊີ Google ຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດ. ຂໍ້ມູນຂອງທ່ານ ນະໂຍບາຍຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວ ຂອງພວກເຮົາອະທິບາຍເຖິງວິທີທີ່ພວກເຮົາປະຕິບັດຕໍ່ຂໍ້ມູນສ່ວນຂອງທ່ານ ແລະ ປົກປ້ອງຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວຂອງທ່ານໃນເວລາທີ່ທ່ານໃຊ້ການບໍລິການ. ແຈ້ງການ ປະກາດຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວຂອງ YouTube Kids ສະໜອງຂໍ້ມູນເພີ່ມເຕີມກ່ຽວກັບວິທີປະຕິບັດເລື່ອງຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວຂອງພວກເຮົາທີ່ມີສະເພາະ YouTube Kids. ພວກເຮົາຈະປະມວນຜົນສຽງ ຫຼື ເນື້ອຫາພາບມີສຽງທີ່ທ່ານໄດ້ອັບໂຫຼດໃສ່ການບໍລິການຕາມ ຂໍ້ກໍານົດການປະມວນຜົນຂໍ້ມູນ YouTube , ຍົກເວັ້ນກໍລະນີທີ່ທ່ານໄດ້ອັບໂຫຼດເນື້ອຫາດັ່ງກ່າວສໍາລັບຈຸດປະສົງສ່ວນຕົວ ຫຼື ການເຄື່ອນໄຫວຂອງຄົວເຮືອນ. ສຶກສາເພີ່ມເຕີມ . ການອະນຸຍາດ ແລະ ການຈໍາກັດ ທ່ານສາມາດເຂົ້າເຖິງ ແລະ ໃຊ້ການບໍລິການທີ່ມີໃຫ້ທ່ານໃຊ້, ຕາບໃດທີ່ທ່ານຍັງປະຕິບັດຕາມຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ແລະ ກົດໝາຍທີ່ມີຜົນບັງຄັບໃຊ້. ທ່ານສາມາດເບິ່ງ ຫຼື ຟັງເນື້ອຫາສໍາລັບການນໍາໃຊ້ສ່ວນຕົວທີ່ບໍ່ແມ່ນໃນທາງການຄ້າ. ທ່ານຍັງສາມາດສະແດງວິດີໂອ YouTube ຜ່ານຕົວຫຼິ້ນ YouTube ທີ່ສາມາດຝັງໄດ້. ຂໍ້ຈໍາກັດຕໍ່ໄປນີ້ແມ່ນມີຜົນກັບການໃຊ້ການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ. ທ່ານບໍ່ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້: ເຂົ້າເຖິງ, ຜະລິດຊ້ຳ, ດາວໂຫຼດ, ເຜີຍແຜ່, ສົ່ງ, ອອກອາກາດ, ສະແດງ, ຈຳໜ່າຍ, ອອກໃບອະນຸຍາດ, ປ່ຽນ, ແກ້ໄຂ ຫຼື ໃຊ້ສ່ວນໃດໜຶ່ງຂອງການບໍລິການ ຫຼື ເນື້ອຫາ ຍົກເວັ້ນກໍລະນີທີ່: (a) ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດຢ່າງຊັດເຈນຈາກການບໍລິການ; ຫຼື (b) ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດຢ່າງເປັນລາຍລັກອັກສອນລ່ວງໜ້າຈາກ YouTube ແລະ ຜູ້ຖືສິດທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ (ຫາກມີ); ຫຼົບຫຼີກ, ປິດການນຳໃຊ້, ມີສ່ວນຮ່ວມໃນການສໍ້ໂກງ ຫຼື ແຊກແຊງກັບສ່ວນໃດໜຶ່ງຂອງການບໍລິການ (ຫຼື ພະຍາຍາມເຮັດສິ່ງໃດໜຶ່ງເຫຼົ່ານີ້) ຮວມທັງຄຸນສົມບັດທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບຄວາມປອດໄພ ຫຼື ຄຸນສົມບັດທີ່ (a) ປ້ອງກັນ ຫຼື ຈຳກັດການສຳເນົາ ຫຼື ການໃຊ້ເນື້ອຫາໃນຮູບແບບອື່ນໆ ຫຼື (b) ຈຳກັດການໃຊ້ການບໍລິການ ຫຼື ເນື້ອຫາ; ເຂົ້າເຖິງບໍລິການໂດຍໃຊ້ວິທີການແບບອັດຕະໂນມັດ (ເຊັ່ນ: ຮຸ່ນຍົນ, botnet ຫຼື scraper) ຍົກເວັ້ນ (a) ໃນກໍລະນີທີ່ໃຊ້ໂປຣແກຣມຊອກຫາສາທາລະນະ, ໂດຍສອດຄ່ອງກັບໄຟລ໌ robots.txt ຂອງ YouTube ຫຼື (b) ໄດ້ຮັບການອະນຸຍາດເປັນລາຍລັກອັກສອນລ່ວງໜ້າຈາກ YouTube; ຮວບຮວມ ຫຼື ເກັບກຳຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ອາດລະບຸຕົວບຸກຄົນໄດ້ (ຕົວຢ່າງ: ຊື່ຜູ້ໃຊ້ ຫຼື ໃບໜ້າ), ເວັ້ນແຕ່ວ່າຈະໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດຈາກບຸກຄົນນັ້ນ ຫຼື ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດພາຍໃຕ້ຂໍ້ທີ (3) ຂ້າງເທິງ; ໃຊ້ບໍລິການເພື່ອເຜີຍແຜ່ເນື້ອຫາໂປຣໂມຊັນ ຫຼື ທາງການຄ້າທີ່ບໍ່ພຶງປະສົງ ຫຼື ການຊັກຊວນທີ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ຕ້ອງການ ຫຼື ແບບມວນຊົນ; ເຮັດໃຫ້ມີ ຫຼື ສົ່ງເສີມໃຫ້ມີການວັດແທກການມີສ່ວນຮ່ວມທີ່ແທ້ຈິງຂອງຜູ້ໃຊ້ກັບການບໍລິການແບບບໍ່ຖືກຕ້ອງ, ຮວມທັງການຈ່າຍເງິນໃຫ້ຄົນ ຫຼື ມອບສິ່ງຈູງໃຈເພື່ອເພີ່ມຍອດເບິ່ງ, ການຖືກໃຈ ຫຼື ການບໍ່ຖືກໃຈວິດີໂອ ຫຼື ເພີ່ມຜູ້ຕິດຕາມຂອງຊ່ອງ ຫຼື ຈັດການການວັດແທກໃນລັກສະນະໃດໜຶ່ງ; ໃຊ້ຂັ້ນຕອນການລາຍງານ, ປັກທຸງ, ຮ້ອງຮຽນ, ໂຕ້ແຍ່ງ ຫຼື ອຸທອນຢ່າງບໍ່ຖືກຕ້ອງ, ຮວມທັງການສົ່ງຂໍ້ມູນທີ່ບໍ່ມີຫຼັກຖານ, ທີ່ລົບກວນ ຫຼື ທີ່ບໍ່ຈິງຈັງ; ດໍາເນີນການແຂ່ງຂັນ ຫຼື ຜ່ານການບໍລິການທີ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ປະຕິບັດຕາມ ນະໂຍບາຍ ແລະ ຂໍ້ແນະນໍາການແຂ່ງຂັນຂອງ YouTube ; ໃຊ້ການບໍລິການເພື່ອເບິ່ງ ຫຼື ຟັງເນື້ອຫາອື່ນທີ່ບໍ່ແມ່ນສໍາລັບການນໍາໃຊ້ສ່ວນຕົວໃນທາງທີ່ບໍ່ແມ່ນທາງການຄ້າ (ຕົວຢ່າງ: ທ່ານບໍ່ສາມາດຖ່າຍທອດວິດີໂອ ຫຼື ສະຕຣີມເພງຈາກການບໍລິການໃນສາທາລະນະໄດ້); ຫຼື ໃຊ້ການບໍລິການເພື່ອ (ກ) ຂາຍການໂຄສະນາ, ການເປັນສະປອນເຊີ ຫຼື ໂປຣໂມຊັນທີ່ວາງຢູ່, ຢູ່ອ້ອມ ຫຼື ພາຍໃນການບໍລິການ ຫຼື ເນື້ອຫານອກເໜືອຈາກສິ່ງທີ່ອະນຸຍາດໃນນະໂຍບາຍ ການໂຄສະນາໃນ YouTube (ເຊັ່ນ: ບ່ອນວາງສິນຄ້າທີ່ຖືກຮ້ອງຮຽນ) ຫຼື (ຂ) ຂາຍການໂຄສະນາ, ການເປັນສະປອນເຊີ ຫຼື ໂປຣໂມຊັນຢູ່ໜ້າໃດໜຶ່ງຂອງເວັບໄຊໃດໜຶ່ງ ຫຼື ແອັບພລິເຄຊັນທີ່ມີເນື້ອຫາຈາກບໍລິການເທົ່ານັ້ນ ຫຼື ໃນບ່ອນທີ່ເນື້ອຫາຈາກການບໍລິການເປັນພື້ນຖານຫຼັກສໍາລັບການຂາຍດັ່ງກ່າວ (ຕົວຢ່າງ: ການຂາຍໂຄສະນາໃນໜ້າເວັບທີ່ວິດີໂອ YouTube ເປັນສິ່ງດຶງດູດຫຼັກສໍາລັບຜູ້ໃຊ້ທີ່ເຂົ້າເບິ່ງໜ້າເວັບ). ການຈອງ ການນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການບໍ່ໄດ້ມອບຄວາມເປັນເຈົ້າຂອງ ຫຼື ສິດຕໍ່ພາກສ່ວນໃດໜຶ່ງຂອງການບໍລິການໃຫ້ແກ່ທ່ານ, ຮວມທັງຊື່ຜູ້ໃຊ້ ຫຼື ເນື້ອຫາອື່ນໆທີ່ໂພສໂດຍຜູ້ອື່ນ ຫຼື YouTube. ພັດທະນາ , ປັບປຸງ ແລະ ອັບເດດການບໍລິການ YouTube ມີການປ່ຽນແປງ ແລະ ປັບປຸງການບໍລິການຢ່າງຕໍ່ເນື່ອງ. ພວກເຮົາອາດດຳເນີນການແກ້ໄຂ ຫຼື ປ່ຽນແປງ (ທຸກສ່ວນ ຫຼື ບາງສ່ວນຂອງການບໍລິການ) ເຊັ່ນ: ເພີ່ມ ຫຼື ລຶບຄຸນສົມບັດ ແລະ ຟັງຊັນການເຮັດວຽກອອກ, ນຳສະເໜີເນື້ອຫາ ຫຼື ການບໍລິການດິຈິຕອນໃໝ່ໆ ຫຼື ປິດໃຫ້ການບໍລິການເກົ່າໆ ເຊິ່ງຖືເປັນສ່ວນໜຶ່ງຂອງການພັດທະນາຢ່າງຕໍ່ເນື່ອງ. ນອກຈາກນັ້ນ, ພວກເຮົາອາດຕ້ອງປ່ຽນ ຫຼື ປິດໃຫ້ການບໍລິການທຸກສ່ວນ ຫຼື ສ່ວນໃດໜຶ່ງຂອງບໍລິການເພື່ອປັບປຸງປະສິດທິພາບ ຫຼື ຄວາມປອດໄພ, ດຳເນີນການປ່ຽນແປງເພື່ອໃຫ້ສອດຄ່ອງກັບກົດໝາຍ ຫຼື ປ້ອງກັນການເຄື່ອນໄຫວທີ່ຜິດກົດໝາຍ ຫຼື ການລະເມີດໃນລະບົບຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ການປ່ຽນແປງເຫຼົ່ານີ້ອາດສົ່ງຜົນກະທົບຕໍ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້ທຸກຄົນ, ຜູ້ໃຊ້ບາງຄົນ ຫຼື ແມ່ນແຕ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້ລາຍບຸກຄົນ. ເມື່ອການບໍລິການກຳນົດໃຫ້ໃຊ້ ຫຼື ມີຊອບແວທີ່ສາມາດດາວໂຫຼດໄດ້ (ເຊັ່ນ: ແອັບພລິເຄຊັນ YouTube Studio), ຊອບແວນັ້ນອາດອັບເດດໂດຍອັດຕະໂນມັດຢູ່ອຸປະກອນຂອງທ່ານເມື່ອມີເວີຊັນ ຫຼື ຄຸນສົມບັດໃໝ່ໃຫ້ນຳໃຊ້, ໂດຍຂຶ້ນກັບການຕັ້ງຄ່າອຸປະກອນຂອງທ່ານ. ຫາກພວກເຮົາດຳເນີນການປ່ຽນແປງທີ່ເປັນສາລະສຳຄັນເຊິ່ງສົ່ງຜົນເສຍຕໍ່ການໃຊ້ການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ, ພວກເຮົາຈະປະກາດແຈ້ງໃຫ້ທ່ານຊາບລ່ວງໜ້າຢ່າງສົມເຫດສົມຜົນ, ຍົກເວັ້ນໃນສະຖານະການຮີບດ່ວນ ເຊັ່ນ: ການປ້ອງກັນການລະເມີດ, ການຕອບສະໜອງຕໍ່ຂໍ້ກຳນົດທາງກົດໝາຍ ຫຼື ການຈັດການບັນຫາດ້ານຄວາມປອດໄພ ແລະ ຄວາມສາມາດໃນການດຳເນີນການ. ນອກຈາກນັ້ນ, ພວກເຮົາຍັງເປີດໂອກາດໃຫ້ທ່ານ ສົ່ງອອກເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານຈາກບັນຊີ Google ຂອງທ່ານໂດຍໃຊ້ Google Takeout , ໂດຍຂຶ້ນກັບກົດໝາຍ ແລະ ນະໂຍບາຍທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ. ເນື້ອຫາ ແລະ ການປະຕິບັດຂອງທ່ານ ກໍາລັງອັບໂຫຼດເນື້ອຫາ ຖ້າທ່ານມີຊ່ອງ YouTube, ທ່ານຈະສາມາດອັບໂຫຼດເນື້ອຫາໃສ່ການບໍລິການໄດ້. ທ່ານສາມາດໃຊ້ເນື້ອຫາເພື່ອສົ່ງເສີມທຸລະກິດ ຫຼື ວິສາຫະກິດສິນລະປະຂອງທ່ານ. ຖ້າທ່ານເລືອກທີ່ຈະອັບໂຫຼດເນື້ອຫາ, ທ່ານຕ້ອງບໍ່ອັບໂຫຼດເນື້ອຫາໃດໜຶ່ງທີ່ບໍ່ປະຕິບັດຕາມຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ໃສ່ການບໍລິການ (ຮວມທັງ ຂໍ້ແນະນຳຊຸມຊົນ YouTube ) ຫຼື ກົດໝາຍ. ຕົວຢ່າງ: ເນື້ອຫາທີ່ທ່ານອັບໂຫຼດຕ້ອງບໍ່ມີຊັບສິນທາງປັນຍາຂອງບຸກຄົນທີສາມ (ເຊັ່ນ: ສິ່ງທີ່ມີລິຂະສິດ) ເວັ້ນເສຍແຕ່ວ່າທ່ານຈະໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດຈາກພາກສ່ວນນັ້ນ ຫຼື ມີສິດທາງກົດໝາຍໃນການເຮັດເຊັ່ນນັ້ນ. ທ່ານມີຄວາມຮັບຜິດຊອບຕາມກົດໝາຍຕໍ່ເນື້ອຫາທີ່ທ່ານອັບໂຫຼດໃສ່ການບໍລິການ. ພວກເຮົາອາດຈະໃຊ້ລະບົບອັດຕະໂນມັດທີ່ວິເຄາະເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານເພື່ອຊ່ວຍກວດຫາການລະເມີດສິດ ແລະ ການລະເມີດເຊັ່ນ: ສະແປມ, ເມົາແວ ແລະ ເນື້ອຫາທີ່ຜິດກົດໝາຍ. ສິດທີ່ທ່ານມອບ ທ່ານຈະຮັກສາສິດໃນການເປັນເຈົ້າຂອງໃນເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານ. ຢ່າງໃດກໍຕາມ, ພວກເຮົາຮຽກຮ້ອງໃຫ້ທ່ານມອບສິດບາງຢ່າງໃຫ້ແກ່ YouTube ແລະ ຜູ້ໃຊ້ບໍລິການຄົນອື່ນໆ, ຕາມທີ່ອະທິບາຍລຸ່ມນີ້. ການໃຫ້ອະນຸຍາດແກ່ YouTube ໂດຍການສົ່ງເນື້ອຫາໄປໃຫ້ການບໍລິການ, ແມ່ນຖືວ່າທ່ານອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ນຳໃຊ້ແບບຄອບຄຸມທົ່ວໂລກ, ບໍ່ຜູກຂາດ, ບໍ່ມີຄ່າລິຂະສິດ, ອອກໃບອະນຸຍາດຍ່ອຍໄດ້ ແລະ ໂອນໄດ້ແກ່ YouTube ເພື່ອໃຊ້ເນື້ອຫານັ້ນ (ຮວມທັງເພື່ອຜະລິດຊ້ຳ, ເຜີຍແຜ່, ກະກຽມຜົນງານຮຽນແບບ, ສະແດງ ແລະ ດຳເນີນການ) ທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບການບໍລິການ ແລະ ທຸລະກິດຂອງ YouTube (ຮວມທັງຜູ້ຮັບມອບໝາຍ ແລະ ບໍລິສັດໃນເຄືອ), ຮວມທັງເພື່ອຈຸດປະສົງໃນການສົ່ງເສີມ ແລະ ເຜີຍແຜ່ສ່ວນໃດໜຶ່ງ ຫຼື ທັງໝົດຂອງການບໍລິການຊ້ຳ. ອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ຜູ້ໃຊ້ອື່ນ ທ່ານຍັງມອບອະນຸຍາດແບບທົ່ວໂລກ, ບໍ່ຜູກຂາດ ແລະ ບໍ່ມີຄ່າລິຂະສິດໃຫ້ຜູ້ໃຊ້ການບໍລິການແຕ່ລະຄົນເພື່ອເຂົ້າເຖິງເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານຜ່ານການບໍລິການ ແລະ ເພື່ອນໍາໃຊ້ເນື້ອຫານັ້ນ, ຮວມທັງການຜະລິດຊໍ້າ, ການເຜີຍແຜ່, ການກຽມຜົນງານຮຽນແບບ, ການສະແດງ ແລະ ການນໍາສະແດງມັນ, ຕາມທີ່ເປີດການນຳໃຊ້ໂດຍຄຸນສົມບັດຂອງການບໍລິການເທົ່ານັ້ນ (ເຊັ່ນ: ການຫຼິ້ນວິດີໂອ ຫຼື ການຝັງ). ເພື່ອຄວາມຊັດເຈນ, ການອະນຸຍາດນີ້ບໍ່ໄດ້ມອບສິດ ຫຼື ການອະນຸຍາດໃດໆໃຫ້ແກ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້ໃນການນໍາໃຊ້ເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ມີການບໍລິການ. ໄລຍະເວລາຂອງໃບອະນຸຍາດ ການອະນຸຍາດຕ່າງໆທີ່ມອບໂດຍທ່ານຈະສືບຕໍ່ມີໃນໄລຍະເວລາທີ່ເໝາະສົມທາງການຄ້າຫຼັງຈາກທີ່ທ່ານໄດ້ຖອນ ຫຼື ລຶບເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານຈາກການບໍລິການແລ້ວ. ຢ່າງໃດກໍຕາມ, ທ່ານເຂົ້າໃຈ ແລະ ເຫັນດີວ່າ YouTube ສາມາດເກັບຮັກສາໄດ້ ແຕ່ບໍ່ໃຫ້ສະແດງ, ເຜີຍແຜ່ ຫຼື ນໍາສະແດງ ສໍາເນົາເຊີບເວີວິດີໂອຂອງທ່ານທີ່ຖືກຖອນ ຫຼື ລຶບອອກແລ້ວ. ສິດໃນການສ້າງລາຍໄດ້ ທ່ານໃຫ້ສິດ YouTube ໃນການສ້າງລາຍໄດ້ຈາກເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານທີ່ຢູ່ໃນການບໍລິການ (ແລະ ການສ້າງລາຍໄດ້ດັ່ງກ່າວອາດຮວມມີການສະແດງໂຄສະນາຢູ່ ຫຼື ພາຍໃນເນື້ອຫາ ຫຼື ການຮຽກເກັບຄ່າບໍລິການເຂົ້າເຖິງຈາກຜູ້ໃຊ້). ຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ບໍ່ໄດ້ເປັນການໃຫ້ສິດທ່ານໃນການຮັບການຈ່າຍເງິນໃດໆ. ເລີ່ມຕັ້ງແຕ່ວັນທີ 18 ພະຈິກ 2020 ເປັນຕົ້ນໄປ, ການຈ່າຍເງິນໃດໆທີ່ທ່ານອາດມີສິດໄດ້ຮັບຈາກ YouTube ພາຍໃຕ້ຂໍ້ຕົກລົງອື່ນໃດໆລະຫວ່າງທ່ານ ແລະ YouTube (ຕົວຢ່າງ: ຮວມທັງການຈ່າຍເງິນພາຍໃຕ້ໂຄງການຮຸ້ນສ່ວນ YouTube, ການເປັນສະມາຊິກຊ່ອງ ຫຼື Super Chat) ຈະຖືວ່າເປັນຄ່າລິຂະສິດ. ຫາກກົດໝາຍກຳນົດ, Google ຈະຫັກອາກອນຫັກຢູ່ບ່ອນຈ່າຍຈາກການຈ່າຍເງິນດັ່ງກ່າວ. ການລຶບເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານ ທ່ານສາມາດ ລຶບເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານ ອອກຈາກການບໍລິການໄດ້ທຸກເວລາ. ທ່ານຍັງມີຕົວເລືອກໃນການ ສໍາເນົາເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານ ກ່ອນລຶບມັນ. ທ່ານຕ້ອງລຶບເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານຖ້າທ່ານບໍ່ມີສິດຕາມທີ່ກໍານົດໄວ້ໃນຂໍ້ກໍານົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້ອີກຕໍ່ໄປ. ການລຶບເນື້ອຫາອອກໂດຍ YouTube ຫາກເນື້ອຫາໃດໆຂອງທ່ານ (1) ລະເມີດຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ຫຼື (2) ອາດກໍ່ໃຫ້ເກີດອັນຕະລາຍຕໍ່ YouTube, ຜູ້ໃຊ້ ຫຼື ບຸກຄົນທີສາມຂອງພວກເຮົາ, ພວກເຮົາຂໍສະຫງວນສິດທີ່ຈະລຶບ ຫຼື ເອົາເນື້ອຫາດັ່ງກ່າວອອກບາງສ່ວນ ຫຼື ທັງໝົດຕາມທີ່ພວກເຮົາເຫັນສົມຄວນ. ພວກເຮົາຈະແຈ້ງເຫດຜົນສຳລັບການດຳເນີນການຂອງພວກເຮົາໃຫ້ທ່ານຊາບ ເວັ້ນແຕ່ວ່າພວກເຮົາຈະມີເຫດຜົນໃຫ້ເຊື່ອວ່າການດຳເນີນການດັ່ງກ່າວ: (a) ອາດລະເມີດກົດໝາຍ ຫຼື ແນວທາງຂອງໜ່ວຍງານບັງຄັບໃຊ້ກົດໝາຍ ຫຼື ອາດເຮັດໃຫ້ YouTube ຫຼື ບໍລິສັດໃນເຄືອຂອງພວກເຮົາສ່ຽງຕໍ່ຄວາມຮັບຜິດຊອບທາງກົດໝາຍ; (b) ອາດສົ່ງຜົນເສຍຕໍ່ການສືບສວນ ຫຼື ຄວາມໜ້າເຊື່ອຖື ຫຼື ການດຳເນີນການຂອງການບໍລິການ; ຫຼື (c) ອາດກໍ່ໃຫ້ເກີດອັນຕະລາຍຕໍ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້, ບຸກຄົນທີສາມອື່ນໆ, YouTube ຫຼື ບໍລິສັດໃນເຄືອຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ທ່ານສາມາດສຶກສາເພີ່ມເຕີມກ່ຽວກັບການລາຍງານ ແລະ ການບັງຄັບໃຊ້, ຮວມທັງວິທີອຸທອນກ່ຽວກັບໜ້າ ການແກ້ບັນຫາ ໃນສູນຊ່ວຍເຫຼືອຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ການປະທ້ວງຂໍ້ແນະນຳຊຸມຊົນ YouTube ດໍາເນີນລະບົບ “ປະທ້ວງ” ເຊິ່ງກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບເນື້ອຫາທີ່ລະເມີດ ຂໍ້ແນະນຳຊຸມຊົນ YouTube . ການປະທ້ວງແຕ່ລະເທື່ອມີຂໍ້ຈຳກັດທີ່ແຕກຕ່າງກັນ ແລະ ອາດສົ່ງຜົນໃຫ້ມີການລຶບຊ່ອງຂອງທ່ານອອກຈາກ YouTube ຢ່າງຖາວອນ. ເບິ່ງຄຳອະທິບາຍໂດຍລະອຽດກ່ຽວກັບການປະທ້ວງມີຜົນກະທົບຕໍ່ຊ່ອງຂອງທ່ານແນວໃດໄດ້ໃນໜ້າ ພື້ນຖານການປະທ້ວງຂໍ້ແນະນຳຊຸມຊົນ . ຫາກທ່ານເຊື່ອວ່າໄດ້ຮັບການປະທ້ວງໂດຍຄວາມຜິດພາດ, ທ່ານກໍສາມາດອຸທອນໄດ້ ບ່ອນນີ້ . ຖ້າຊ່ອງຂອງທ່ານຖືກຈໍາກັດເນື່ອງຈາກການປະທ້ວງ, ທ່ານຕ້ອງບໍ່ໃຊ້ຊ່ອງອື່ນເພື່ອຫຼີກເວັ້ນການຈໍາກັດເຫຼົ່ານີ້. ການລະເມີດຂໍ້ຫ້າມນີ້ແມ່ນການລະເມີດຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ແລະ Google ສະຫງວນສິດໃນການປິດບັນຊີ Google ຂອງທ່ານ ຫຼື ການເຂົ້າເຖິງບໍລິການທັງໝົດ ຫຼື ບາງສ່ວນຂອງທ່ານ. ການປົກປ້ອງລິຂະສິດ ພວກເຮົາສະໜອງຂໍ້ມູນເພື່ອຊ່ວຍຜູ້ຖືລິຂະສິດຈັດການກັບຊັບສິນທາງປັນຍາຂອງພວກເຂົາທາງອອນລາຍໃນ ສູນລິຂະສິດ YouTube ຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ຖ້າທ່ານເຊື່ອວ່າລິຂະສິດຂອງທ່ານຖືກລະເມີດໃນການບໍລິການ, ກະລຸນາ ສົ່ງແຈ້ງການເຖິງພວກເຮົາ . ພວກເຮົາຕອບແຈ້ງການກ່ຽວກັບການລະເມີດລິຂະສິດທີ່ສົງໄສຕາມຂະບວນການໃນ ສູນລິຂະສິດ YouTube ຂອງພວກເຮົາໃນບ່ອນທີ່ທ່ານຍັງສາມາດຊອກຫາຂໍ້ມູນກ່ຽວກັບວິທີແກ້ໄຂການປະທ້ວງລິຂະສິດ. ນະໂຍບາຍຂອງ YouTube ກໍານົດໃຫ້ມີການຢຸດຕິການເຂົ້າເຖິງການບໍລິການຂອງຜູ້ລະເມີດທີ່ເຮັດຜິດຊໍ້າໆ, ໃນສະຖານະການທີ່ເໝາະສົມ. ການລະງັບ ແລະ ການປິດບັນຊີ ການປິດບັນຊີໂດຍທ່ານ ທ່ານສາມາດຢຸດນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການໄດ້ທຸກເວລາ. ໃຫ້ປະຕິບັດຕາມ ຄຳແນະນຳ ເຫຼົ່ານີ້ເພື່ອລຶບບໍລິການຈາກບັນຊີ Google ຂອງທ່ານ, ເຊິ່ງກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບການປິດຊ່ອງ YouTube ແລະ ການລຶບຂໍ້ມູນຂອງທ່ານ. ທ່ານຍັງມີທາງເລືອກໃນການດາວໂຫຼດສໍາເນົາຂໍ້ມູນຂອງທ່ານກ່ອນ. ການປິດບັນຊີ ແລະ ການລະງັບໂດຍ YouTube YouTube ຂໍສະຫງວນສິດໃນການລະງັບ ຫຼື ປິດບັນຊີ Google ຂອງທ່ານ ຫຼື ການເຂົ້າເຖິງການບໍລິການທັງໝົດ ຫຼື ບາງສ່ວນຂອງທ່ານ ໃນກໍລະນີທີ່ (a) ທ່ານລະເມີດຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ຊ້ຳໆ ຫຼື ຢ່າງຮ້າຍແຮງ; (b) ພວກເຮົາຈຳເປັນຕ້ອງປະຕິບັດຕາມຂໍ້ກຳນົດທາງກົດໝາຍ ຫຼື ຄຳສັ່ງຂອງສານ; ຫຼື (c) ພວກເຮົາມີເຫດຜົນໃຫ້ເຊື່ອວ່າໄດ້ມີການກະທຳທີ່ກໍ່ໃຫ້ເກີດ (ຫຼື ອາດກໍ່ໃຫ້ເກີດ) ຄວາມຮັບຜິດຊອບ ຫຼື ເປັນອັນຕະລາຍຕໍ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້, ບຸກຄົນທີສາມອື່ນໆ, YouTube ຫຼື ບໍລິສັດໃນເຄືອຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ແຈ້ງການສຳລັບການປິດບັນຊີ ຫຼື ການລະງັບ ພວກເຮົາຈະແຈ້ງທ່ານກ່ຽວກັບເຫດຜົນສໍາລັບການປິດບັນຊີ ຫຼື ລະງັບໂດຍ YouTube ເວັ້ນເສຍແຕ່ພວກເຮົາຈະເຊື່ອວ່າການເຮັດເຊັ່ນນັ້ນ: (ກ) ຈະເປັນການລະເມີດກົດໝາຍ ຫຼື ທິດຊີ້ນໍາຂອງເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່ບັງຄັບໃຊ້ກົດໝາຍ; (ຂ) ຈະກະທົບການສືບສວນ; (ຄ) ຈະກະທົບຄວາມຖືກຕ້ອງ, ການດໍາເນີນງານ ຫຼື ຄວາມປອດໄພຂອງການບໍລິການ ຫຼື (ງ) ຈະເຮັດໃຫ້ມີຄວາມສ່ຽງຕໍ່ຜູ້ໃຊ້, ບຸກຄົນທີສາມອື່ນໆ, YouTube ຫຼື ບໍລິສັດໃນເຄືອຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ຜົນຈາກການລະງັບ ຫຼື ປິດບັນຊີ ຫາກບັນຊີ Google ຂອງທ່ານຖືກປິດລົງ ຫຼື ການເຂົ້າເຖິງການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານຖືກຈຳກັດ, ທ່ານກໍອາດສືບຕໍ່ໃຊ້ການບໍລິການບາງສ່ວນ (ເຊັ່ນ: ການເບິ່ງຢ່າງດຽວ) ໄດ້ໂດຍບໍ່ມີບັນຊີ ແລະ ຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ຈະຍັງມີຜົນກັບການນຳໃຊ້ດັ່ງກ່າວຕໍ່ໄປ. ຫາກທ່ານເຊື່ອວ່າການປິດບັນຊີ ຫຼື ການລະງັບແມ່ນເກີດຈາກຂໍ້ຜິດພາດ, ທ່ານກໍສາມາດ ອຸທອນໂດຍໃຊ້ແບບຟອມນີ້ ໄດ້. ກ່ຽວກັບຊອບແວໃນບໍລິການ ຊອບແວທີ່ສາມາດດາວໂຫຼດໄດ້ ເມື່ອການບໍລິການຕ້ອງການ ຫຼື ຮວມມີຊອບແວທີ່ສາມາດດາວໂຫຼດໄດ້ (ເຊັ່ນ: ແອັບພລິເຄຊັນ YouTube Studio), ເວັ້ນເສຍແຕ່ຊອບແວນັ້ນແມ່ນຖືກຄຸ້ມຄອງໂດຍຂໍ້ກໍານົດເພີ່ມເຕີມທີ່ສະໜອງການອະນຸຍາດ, YouTube ຈະມອບການອະນຸຍາດແບບສ່ວນຕົວ, ທົ່ວໂລກ, ບໍ່ມີຄ່າລິຂະສິດ, ບໍ່ສາມາດມອບໝາຍໄດ້ ແລະ ບໍ່ຜູກຂາດໃຫ້ແກ່ທ່ານເພື່ອນໍາໃຊ້ຊອບແວທີ່ສະໜອງໃຫ້ທ່ານໂດຍ YouTube ໃນການເປັນສ່ວນໜຶ່ງຂອງການບໍລິການ. ການອະນຸຍາດນີ້ແມ່ນສໍາລັບຈຸດປະສົງໃນການເຮັດໃຫ້ທ່ານສາມາດນໍາໃຊ້ ແລະ ເພີດເພີນກັບຜົນປະໂຫຍດຈາກການບໍລິການທີ່ສະໜອງໂດຍ YouTube ເທົ່ານັ້ນໃນລັກສະນະທີ່ອະນຸຍາດໂດຍຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້. ທ່ານບໍ່ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ສໍາເນົາ, ແກ້ໄຂ, ເຜີຍແຜ່, ຂາຍ ຫຼື ໃຫ້ເຊົ່າສ່ວນໃດໜຶ່ງຂອງຊອບແວ ຫຼື ເຮັດວິສະວະກຳຍ້ອນກັບ ຫຼື ພະຍາຍາມແກະຊອດໂຄດຂອງຊອບແວນັ້ນ, ເວັ້ນເສຍແຕ່ກົດໝາຍຫ້າມບໍ່ໃຫ້ມີຂໍ້ຈໍາກັດເຫຼົ່ານີ້ ຫຼື ທ່ານໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດຢ່າງເປັນລາຍລັກອັກສອນຈາກ YouTube. ໂອເພນຊອດ ບາງຊອບແວໃນການບໍລິການຂອງພວກເຮົາອາດຈະຖືກສະໜອງພາຍໃຕ້ໃບອະນຸຍາດໂອເພນຊອດທີ່ພວກເຮົາມອບໃຫ້ທ່ານ. ອາດຈະມີຂໍ້ບັນຍັດໃນໃບອະນຸຍາດໂອເພນຊອດທີ່ຍົກເລີກບາງຂໍ້ກໍານົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້, ສະນັ້ນກະລຸນາອ່ານໃບອະນຸຍາດເຫຼົ່ານັ້ນ. ຂໍ້ກຳນົດອື່ນໆທາງກົດໝາຍ ການປະຕິເສດການຮັບປະກັນ ນອກຈາກທີ່ໄດ້ລະບຸໄວ້ຢ່າງຊັດເຈນໃນຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ຫຼື ຕາມທີ່ກໍານົດໄວ້ໃນກົດໝາຍ, ການບໍລິການແມ່ນສະໜອງໃຫ້ "ຕາມແບບທີ່ເປັນຢູ່" ແລະ YouTube ບໍ່ເຮັດຂໍ້ຕົກລົງສະເພາະ ຫຼື ການຮັບປະກັນໃດໆກ່ຽວກັບການບໍລິການດັ່ງກ່າວ. ຕົວຢ່າງ: ພວກເຮົາບໍ່ໄດ້ໃຫ້ການຮັບປະກັນໃດໆກ່ຽວກັບ: (A) ເນື້ອຫາທີ່ມີໃຫ້ຜ່ານການບໍລິການ; (B) ຄຸນສົມບັດສະເພາະຂອງການບໍລິການ ຫຼື ຄວາມຖືກຕ້ອງ, ຄວາມໜ້າເຊື່ອຖື, ຄວາມພ້ອມນຳໃຊ້ ຫຼື ຄວາມສາມາດໃນການຕອບສະໜອງຄວາມຕ້ອງການຂອງທ່ານ; ຫຼື (C) ເນື້ອຫາໃດໆທີ່ທ່ານສົ່ງຈະສາມາດເຂົ້າເຖິງໄດ້ໃນການບໍລິການ. ຂີດຈຳກັດຄວາມຮັບຜິດຊອບ ເວັ້ນແຕ່ກົດໝາຍທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກຳນົດໄວ້, YouTube, ບໍລິສັດໃນເຄືອ, ເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່, ຜູ້ບໍລິຫານ, ພະນັກງານ ແລະ ຕົວແທນຈະບໍ່ຮັບຜິດຊອບຕໍ່ການສູນເສຍຜົນກຳໄລ, ລາຍໄດ້, ໂອກາດທາງທຸລະກິດ, ຄ່າຄວາມນິຍົມ ຫຼື ຄວາມບໍ່ຖືກຕ້ອງຂອງການບໍລິການ; ການບາດເຈັບ ຫຼື ຄວາມເສຍຫາຍຕໍ່ຊັບສິນເຊິ່ງເປັນຜົນມາຈາກການນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ; ການເຂົ້າເຖິງ ຫຼື ການນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການໂດຍບໍ່ໄດ້ຮັບອະນຸຍາດ; ການຂັດຂວາງ ຫຼື ການຢຸດການບໍລິການ; ໄວຣັສ ຫຼື ລະຫັດທີ່ເປັນອັນຕະລາຍເຊິ່ງບຸກຄົນທີສາມໃດໆສົ່ງໄປຫາ ຫຼື ສົ່ງຜ່ານການບໍລິການ; ເນື້ອຫາໃດໜຶ່ງທີ່ສົ່ງໂດຍຜູ້ໃຊ້ ຫຼື YouTube, ຮວມທັງການນໍາໃຊ້ເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານ ແລະ/ຫຼື ການລຶບ ຫຼື ການບໍ່ມີເນື້ອຫາໃດໜຶ່ງ. ເດືອນກ່ອນວັນທີທີ່ທ່ານຍື່ນການອ້າງສິດດັ່ງກ່າວເປັນລາຍລັກອັກສອນມາຫາ YouTube; ແລະ (B) USD $500. ການຊົດເຊີຍ ຕາມຂອບເຂດທີ່ອະນຸຍາດໂດຍກົດໝາຍທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ, ທ່ານເຫັນດີປ້ອງກັນ, ຊົດເຊີຍ ແລະ ລະງັບໄພອັນຕະລາຍຕໍ່ YouTube, ບໍລິສັດໃນເຄືອ, ເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່, ຜູ້ອໍານວຍການ, ພະນັກງານ ແລະ ຕົວແທນ, ຈາກ ແລະ ຕໍ່ການອ້າງສິດ, ຄວາມເສຍຫາຍ, ພັນທະ, ການສູນເສຍ, ຄວາມຮັບຜິດຊອບ, ຄ່າໃຊ້ຈ່າຍ ຫຼື ໜີ້ສິນ ແລະ ລາຍຈ່າຍໃດໜຶ່ງ ຫຼື ທັງໝົດ (ຮວມທັງ ແຕ່ບໍ່ຈໍາກັດພຽງຄ່າຈ້າງທະນາຍຄວາມ) ທີ່ເກີດຈາກ: (i) ການນໍາໃຊ້ ແລະ ການເຂົ້າເຖິງການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ; (ii) ການລະເມີດຂໍ້ກໍານົດໃດໜຶ່ງໃນຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ຂອງທ່ານ; (iii) ການລະເມີດສິດຂອງບຸກຄົນທີສາມຂອງທ່ານ, ຮວມທັງ ແຕ່ບໍ່ຈໍາກັດພຽງລິຂະສິດ, ຊັບສິນ ຫຼື ສິດຕໍ່ຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວ ຫຼື (iv) ການອ້າງສິດວ່າເນື້ອຫາຂອງທ່ານໄດ້ສ້າງຄວາມເສຍຫາຍແກ່ບຸກຄົນທີສາມ. ການປ້ອງກັນນີ້ ແລະ ພັນທະໃນການຊົດເຊີຍຈະຍັງຄົງມີຜົນນໍາໃຊ້ໃນຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ແລະ ການນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານ. ລິ້ງ ຫາບຸກຄົນ ທີສາມ ການ ບໍລິການອາດຈະມີລິ້ງຫາເວັບໄຊ ແລະ ການບໍລິການອອນລາຍຂອງບຸກຄົນທີສາມທີ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ເປັນຂອງ ຫຼື ຄວບຄຸມໂດຍ YouTube. YouTube ບໍ່ມີການຄວບຄຸມ ແລະ ບໍ່ມີຄວາມຮັບຜິດຊອບຕໍ່ເວັບໄຊ ແລະ ການບໍລິການອອນລາຍດັ່ງກ່າວ. ກະລຸນາຮັບຊາບວ່າເມື່ອທ່ານອອກຈາກການບໍລິການ, ພວກເຮົາແນະນໍາໃຫ້ທ່ານອ່ານຂໍ້ກໍານົດ ແລະ ນະໂຍບາຍຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວຂອງເວັບໄຊ ແລະ ການບໍລິການອອນລາຍຂອງບຸກຄົນທີສາມທີ່ທ່ານເຂົ້າເບິ່ງ. ກ່ຽວກັບຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ການປ່ຽນແປງຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ພວກເຮົາອາດປ່ຽນແປງຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້, ຕົວຢ່າງ: (1) ເພື່ອໃຫ້ເປັນໄປຕາມການປ່ຽນແປງໃນການບໍລິການຂອງພວກເຮົາ ຫຼື ວິທີທີ່ພວກເຮົາດຳເນີນທຸລະກິດ, ຕົວຢ່າງ: ເມື່ອພວກເຮົາເພີ່ມຜະລິດຕະພັນ ຫຼື ຄຸນສົມບັດໃໝ່ໆ ຫຼື ລຶບອັນເກົ່າອອກ, (2) ສຳລັບເຫດຜົນທາງກົດໝາຍ, ຂໍ້ບັງຄັບ ຫຼື ຄວາມປອດໄພ ຫຼື (3) ເພື່ອປ້ອງກັນການລະເມີດ ຫຼື ອັນຕະລາຍ. ຖ້າພວກເຮົາປ່ຽນຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້, ພວກເຮົາຈະສົ່ງແຈ້ງການລ່ວງໜ້າທີ່ສົມເຫດສົມຜົນໃຫ້ແກ່ທ່ານ ແລະ ໂອກາດໃຫ້ກວດສອບການປ່ຽນແປງ, ເວັ້ນເສຍແຕ່ (1) ໃນເວລາທີ່ພວກເຮົາເປີດໃຊ້ຜະລິດຕະພັນ ຫຼື ຄຸນສົມບັດໃໝ່ ຫຼື (2) ໃນສະຖານະການຮີບດ່ວນ, ເຊັ່ນ: ການປ້ອງກັນການລະເມີດທີ່ພວມມີຢູ່ ຫຼື ການປະຕິບັດຕາມຂໍ້ກໍານົດທາງກົດໝາຍ. ຖ້າທ່ານບໍ່ເຫັນດີກັບຂໍ້ກໍານົດໃໝ່, ທ່ານຄວນລຶບທຸກເນື້ອຫາທີ່ທ່ານໄດ້ອັບໂຫຼດແລ້ວຢຸດນໍາໃຊ້ການບໍລິການດັ່ງກ່າວ. ຄວາມຕໍ່ເນື່ອງຂອງຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ຫາກການໃຊ້ການບໍລິການຂອງທ່ານສິ້ນສຸດລົງ, ຂໍ້ກຳນົດຕໍ່ໄປນີ້ຂອງຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ຈະມີຜົນນຳໃຊ້ກັບທ່ານຕໍ່ໄປ: “ຂໍ້ກຳນົດອື່ນໆທາງກົດໝາຍ”, “ກ່ຽວກັບຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້” ແລະ ການໃຫ້ໃບອະນຸຍາດຂອງທ່ານຈະສືບຕໍ່ມີຜົນນຳໃຊ້ຕາມທີ່ອະທິບາຍໄວ້ໃນ “ໄລຍະເວລາຂອງການອະນຸຍາດ”. ການແຍກອອກຈາກກັນໄດ້ ຫາກປາກົດວ່າມີຂໍ້ກຳນົດສະເພາະໃດໜຶ່ງຂອງຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ບໍ່ສາມາດບັງຄັບໃຊ້ໄດ້ບໍ່ວ່າຈະດ້ວຍເຫດຜົນໃດກໍຕາມ, ສິ່ງນີ້ຈະບໍ່ສົ່ງຜົນຕໍ່ຂໍ້ກຳນົດອື່ນໆ. ບໍ່ມີການສະລະສິດ ຫາກທ່ານບໍ່ປະຕິບັດຕາມຂໍ້ຕົກລົງນີ້ ແລະ ພວກເຮົາບໍ່ໄດ້ດຳເນີນການໃນທັນທີ, ສິ່ງນີ້ບໍ່ໄດ້ໝາຍຄວາມວ່າພວກເຮົາສະລະສິດໃດໆທີ່ພວກເຮົາອາດມີ (ເຊັ່ນ: ສິດໃນການດຳເນີນການໃນອະນາຄົດ). ການຕີຄວາມ ໃນຂໍ້ກໍານົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້, “ຮວມມີ” ຫຼື “ຮວມທັງ” ໝາຍເຖິງ “ຮວມທັງ ແຕ່ບໍ່ໄດ້ຈໍາກັດພຽງ” ແລະ ຕົວຢ່າງໃດໜຶ່ງທີ່ພວກເຮົາຍົກຂຶ້ນມາແມ່ນມີຈຸດປະສົງເພື່ອເປັນຕົວຢ່າງປະກອບ. ກົດໝາຍຄຸ້ມຄອງ ການອ້າງສິດທັງໝົດທີ່ເກີດຈາກ ຫຼື ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບຂໍ້ກໍານົດເຫຼົ່ານີ້ ຫຼື ການບໍລິການຈະຖືກຄຸ້ມຄອງໂດຍກົດໝາຍ ແຄລິຟໍເນຍ, ເວັ້ນເສຍແຕ່ການຂັດກັນຂອງກົດລະບຽບດ້ານກົດໝາຍຂອງ ແຄລິຟໍເນຍ ແລະ ຈະມີການດໍາເນີນຄະດີແບບສະເພາະໃນສານລັດຖະບານກາງ ຫຼື ຂອງລັດໃນ ມົນທົນຊານຕາຄລາລາ, ລັດແຄລິຟໍເນຍ, ສະຫະລັດອາເມລິກາ. ທ່ານ ແລະ YouTube ຍິນຍອມໃຫ້ໃຊ້ເຂດອຳນາດສານສ່ວນບຸກຄົນໃນສານເຫຼົ່ານັ້ນ. ຂໍ້ຈຳກັດໃນການດຳເນີນການທາງກົດໝາຍ ທ່ານ ແລະ YouTube ເຫັນດີວ່າສາເຫດຂອງການກະທຳໃດໆທີ່ເກີດຂຶ້ນຈາກ ຫຼື ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບການບໍລິການຈະຕ້ອງເລີ່ມດຳເນີນການພາຍໃນໜຶ່ງ (1) ປີຫຼັງຈາກທີ່ສາເຫດຂອງການກະທຳດັ່ງກ່າວເກີດຂຶ້ນ. ຖ້າບໍ່ດັ່ງກ່າວ, ສາເຫດຂອງການກະທຳດັ່ງກ່າວຈະຖືເປັນໂມຄະຢ່າງຖາວອນ. ມີຜົນຕັ້ງແຕ່ 15 ທັນວາ 2023 ( ເບິ່ງເວີຊັນກ່ອນໜ້າ )

You can’t replace a video since any new video upload will get a new URL, but you can modify the existing video. Delete your own videos You can remove any videos that you uploaded from your own Google Account. When you delete a video, it's permanently deleted. If you’d like to watch the video in the future, make sure you have a backup saved. Sign in to YouTube Studio . From the left menu, select Content . Hover over the video you’d like to delete. Select Options Delete forever . Check the box to acknowledge that your video will be permanently deleted. Select DELETE FOREVER . When you delete a video from your YouTube channel, we immediately start the video removal process and it will no longer be searchable within YouTube. Data associated with the video such as Watch time will still be part of aggregate reports, but will not be attributed to the deleted video. You can also delete videos in bulk . Replace a video You can’t replace a video. Any new video you upload to YouTube will get a new URL. Instead, you can modify an existing video : Trim your video: On a computer, you can cut out the beginning, middle, or end of your video. Add cards to your video: You can use info cards to add new elements to your video. Cards can show specific websites and more. Change your video's title and description: You can organize and change your video's title, category, description, and privacy settings. If you believe your content was removed by mistake, you can submit a counter notification to resolve a copyright strike . For videos, you can submit in YouTube Studio or by email, fax, or mail . For non-video content, such as channel banner images, submit by email, fax, or mail . What to know before you submit: When to submit: Only submit a counter notification if you believe your content was removed due to a mistake. This includes misidentifications of content that may qualify for a copyright exception, such as fair use , fair dealing, or public domain . Other options: If you don't believe the content removal was a mistake, you can wait 90 days and the copyright strike will expire, as long as you've completed Copyright School. You can also try to request a retraction to resolve the copyright strike. Evidence of ownership or permission: Confirm you own the rights to all elements in your content, including any music (even if it’s just playing in the background). If you’ve used someone else’s copyrighted content, confirm you have a license or permission to use it. What info is shared: Legally, we’re required to share the counter notification with the claimant. If disclosing personal information is a concern, an authorized representative (such as an attorney) can submit on the uploader's behalf by email, fax, or mail . Who submits the notification: Counter notifications should be submitted by the original uploader of the content at issue. Alternatively, an authorized representative, such as an attorney, can submit on behalf of the uploader. Do not submit false information . Misuse of our processes, such as submitting fraudulent documentation, may result in the termination of your account or other legal consequences. Submit in YouTube Studio Copyright counter notifications for videos can be submitted in YouTube Studio from a computer or in the YouTube Studio app: Sign in to YouTube Studio . From the left menu, click Content . Click the filter bar Copyright . In the Visibility column, find a video with “Removed” status. In the Restrictions column, hover over Copyright . Click See details . Under Content used , click Take action Submit a counter notification . Read the counter notification requirements and check the box to confirm Continue . Enter your contact info Continue . Make sure you include your complete physical address and full legal name (usually a first and last name). Do not enter a company or channel name. Enter your rationale. Clearly and concisely explain why you believe the removal of your content qualifies as a mistake or misidentification. Review the statements and check the boxes to agree. Enter your full legal name as your signature Continue . (Optional) If other videos were removed from the same removal request and you also believe they were incorrectly removed, you can select these videos and include all of them in the counter notification. Click Submit . Submit by email, fax, or mail Copyright counter notifications for videos and non-video content, such as channel banner images, can be submitted by email, fax, or mail. To submit by email, send all the required information below in the body of an email (not as an attachment) to copyright@youtube.com or send it by fax or mail : 1. Your contact info To get in touch with you, or the representative authorized to act on your behalf, about your counter notification, include the following: Your full legal name: First and last name, not a company name. If you're an authorized representative, also include your relationship to the uploader. Your physical address Your telephone number 2. Statement to the claimant In your own words, you must include a statement to the claimant that clearly and concisely explains why you believe the removal of the content was a mistake or misidentification . Misidentification includes cases of copyright exceptions, such as fair use , fair dealing, or public domain . 3. Links to the content Counter notifications must include direct links to the content that was removed due to a copyright removal request . Links must be sent in a specific URL format, depending on the type of content: Content type Valid URL format Where to find the URL Channel banner images www.youtube.com/channel/UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx OR www.youtube.com/user/xxxxxxxxx Go to the channel page right-click the address bar Copy .​ Channel descriptions www.youtube.com/user/xxxxxxxxx/about Go to channel's About section right-click the address bar Copy .​ Clips www.youtube.com/clip/xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx Click the clip's title right-click the address bar Copy .​ Comments on videos www.youtube.com/watch?v=xxxxxxxxxx&lc=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx Click the posted date above the comment (page will reload) right-click the address bar Copy .​ Comments on posts www.youtube.com/channel/xxxxxxxxxxx/community?lc=xxxxxxxxxxxx&lb=xxxxxxxxxxxx Click the posted date above the comment (page will reload) right-click the address bar Copy .​ Effects (Shorts) www.youtube.com/effect/xxxxxxxxxx Keep in mind: Videos that have already used the Effect aren’t affected by the removal of the Effect. ​Click the Effect chip (above the channel name in the Short) right-click the address bar Copy . Membership badges, emoji, or creator's perk descriptions Beginning with yt3.ggpht.com/xxxxx Right-click the image Copy Image Address .​ Also include the channel URL: www.youtube.com/channel/UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx OR www.youtube.com/user/xxxxxxxxx ​Go to the channel page right-click the address bar Copy .​ Playables www.youtube.com/playables/xxxxxxxxxxxxxx Go to the game page right-click the address bar Copy .​ Playlist descriptions www.youtube.com/playlist?list=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx Click the playlist title right-click the address bar Copy . Playlist image Beginning with https://i.ytimg.com/xxxxxxxxxx Right-click the image Copy Image Address .​ Also include the playlist URL : https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxxxx Click the playlist title right-click the address bar Copy . Posts https://www.youtube.com/post/xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx Click the posted date of the post (page will reload) right-click the address bar Copy . Profile pictures https://yt3.googleusercontent.com/xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ​Click the profile picture right-click the address bar Copy . For expedited removal of profile pictures , copyright removal requests for profile pictures may be submitted through Google’s form . Shorts https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx Go to the Short right-click the address bar Copy . Super Stickers Beginning with lh3.googleusercontent.com/xxxxx Click the dollar sign in a live chat Super Sticker right-click image Copy Image Address . Also include the channel URL: www.youtube.com/channel/UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx OR www.youtube.com/user/xxxxxxxxx Go to the channel page right-click the address bar Copy . Videos www.youtube.com/watch?v=xxxxxxxxxxx Go to the video page right-click the address bar Copy .​ 4. Legal statements Agree to and include the following 2 legally required statements: "I consent to the jurisdiction of the Federal District Court for the district in which my address is located, or if my address is outside of the United States, the judicial district in which YouTube is located, and will accept service of process from the claimant." "I swear, under penalty of perjury, that I have a good faith belief that the material was removed or disabled as a result of a mistake or misidentification of the material to be removed or disabled." 5. Your signature Complete and valid copyright counter notifications require the physical or electronic signature of the uploader or a representative authorized to act on their behalf. To meet this requirement, the uploader or authorized representative should enter their full legal name as their signature at the bottom of the counter notification. A full legal name should be a first and last name, not a company name. Frequently asked questions (FAQs) What happens after I submit a counter notification? If your counter notification is valid and forwarded to the claimant, the associated copyright strike may be cleared from your channel. Counter notifications that don't meet all of the requirements may be rejected. The claimant has 10 US business days, as required by copyright law, to respond to the counter notification . They must respond with evidence of legal action taken to keep your content from being reinstated to YouTube. If the claimant doesn't do this within this 10-day time period, your content will be reinstated to YouTube (unless you have deleted it). How do I check the status of a counter notification I submitted? You can check the status of a counter notification from your YouTube Studio dashboard or follow those steps: Sign in to YouTube Studio . From the left menu, select Content . Click the filter bar Copyright . Find the video in question. In the Restrictions column, hover over Copyright . Click See details . Look under the Content used section to find the status of the counter notification. Can I cancel a counter notification I submitted? If you want to cancel a counter notification, you can as long as the claimant hasn't responded to the counter notification yet. To cancel it, reply directly to YouTube's confirmation email (the email that confirmed the counter notification was received). In your reply, explain that you want to retract your counter notification. You can also email copyright@youtube.com with this information. What happens if my counter notification is rejected? If your counter notification is missing any required information, it may be rejected. You’ll be notified by an email sent to the email address associated with your YouTube channel. The email will have more details on the reason for the rejection. What you can do next: Reconsider if your content has been removed due to a mistake or misidentification of copyrighted content. If not, you can consider other options to resolve a copyright strike . You can submit a new counter notification that includes all legally required information. Can I submit 1 counter notification for multiple videos? Yes, if multiple videos belong to the same copyright strike and you believe they were incorrectly removed, you can submit 1 counter notification for all videos. If my channel is terminated, can I submit a counter notification? Yes. You can submit a counter notification in YouTube Studio or by email, fax, or mail . How do I submit a counter notification as an EU DSA Article 86 designated organization? Counter notifications from EU DSA Article 86 designated organizations should be submitted by email, fax, or postal mail . Additional requirements: Use an email domain associated with an EU DSA Article 86 designated organization. State the country of primary residence of the content owner. Include the phrase “I am submitting this appeal on behalf of a YouTube user in the European Union. I represent an organization that is authorized to exercise rights conferred by the Digital Services Act Regulation 2022 (EU) 2022/2065.” Was this helpful? How can we improve it? title: The Egg
text: Printer Friendly Version Back to Writings Page You can use the anchors to remember your place. In FireFox, right click an anchor and select "Bookmark This Link". For Internet Explorer, click the anchor, then select "Add to Favorites" from the Favorites menu. The Egg Author's Note: The Egg is also available in the following languages: Arabic Bulgarian Chinese Croatian Czech Danish Dutch Esperanto Estonian Finnish French German Greek Hebrew Hungarian Italian Japanese Korean Lithuanian Macedonian Norwegian (Bokmål) Norwegian (Nynorsk) Polish Portuguese (Portugal) Portuguese (Brazil) Romanian Russian Spanish Swedish Turkish Vietnamese The Egg By: Andy Weir You were on your way home when you died. It was a car accident. Nothing particularly remarkable, but fatal nonetheless. You left behind a wife and two children. It was a painless death. The EMTs tried their best to save you, but to no avail. Your body was so utterly shattered you were better off, trust me. And thats when you met me. What what happened? You asked. Where am I? You died, I said, matter-of-factly. No point in mincing words. There was a a truck and it was skidding  Yup, I said. I I died? Yup. But dont feel bad about it. Everyone dies, I said. You looked around. There was nothingness. Just you and me. What is this place? You asked. Is this the afterlife? More or less, I said. Are you god? You asked. Yup, I replied. Im God. My kids my wife, you said. What about them? Will they be all right? Thats what I like to see, I said. You just died and your main concern is for your family. Thats good stuff right there. You looked at me with fascination. To you, I didnt look like God. I just looked like some man. Or possibly a woman. Some vague authority figure, maybe. More of a grammar school teacher than the almighty. Dont worry, I said. Theyll be fine. Your kids will remember you as perfect in every way. They didnt have time to grow contempt for you. Your wife will cry on the outside, but will be secretly relieved. To be fair, your marriage was falling apart. If its any consolation, shell feel very guilty for feeling relieved. Oh, you said. So what happens now? Do I go to heaven or hell or something? Neither, I said. Youll be reincarnated. Ah, you said. So the Hindus were right, All religions are right in their own way, I said. Walk with me. You followed along as we strode through the void. Where are we going? Nowhere in particular, I said. Its just nice to walk while we talk. So whats the point, then? You asked. When I get reborn, Ill just be a blank slate, right? A baby. So all my experiences and everything I did in this life wont matter. Not so! I said. You have within you all the knowledge and experiences of all your past lives. You just dont remember them right now. I stopped walking and took you by the shoulders. Your soul is more magnificent, beautiful, and gigantic than you can possibly imagine. A human mind can only contain a tiny fraction of what you are. Its like sticking your finger in a glass of water to see if its hot or cold. You put a tiny part of yourself into the vessel, and when you bring it back out, youve gained all the experiences it had. Youve been in a human for the last 48 years, so you havent stretched out yet and felt the rest of your immense consciousness. If we hung out here for long enough, youd start remembering everything. But theres no point to doing that between each life. How many times have I been reincarnated, then? Oh lots. Lots and lots. An in to lots of different lives. I said. This time around, youll be a Chinese peasant girl in 540 AD. Wait, what? You stammered. Youre sending me back in time? Well, I guess technically. Time, as you know it, only exists in your universe. Things are different where I come from. Where you come from? You said. Oh sure, I explained I come from somewhere. Somewhere else. And there are others like me. I know youll want to know what its like there, but honestly you wouldnt understand. Oh, you said, a little let down. But wait. If I get reincarnated to other places in time, I could have interacted with myself at some point. Sure. Happens all the time. And with both lives only aware of their own lifespan you dont even know its happening. So whats the point of it all? Seriously? I asked. Seriously? Youre asking me for the meaning of life? Isnt that a little stereotypical? Well its a reasonable question, you persisted. I looked you in the eye. The meaning of life, the reason I made this whole universe, is for you to mature. You mean mankind? You want us to mature? No, just you. I made this whole universe for you. With each new life you grow and mature and become a larger and greater intellect. Just me? What about everyone else? There is no one else, I said. In this universe, theres just you and me. You stared blankly at me. But all the people on earth  All you. Different incarnations of you. Wait. Im everyone !? Now youre getting it, I said, with a congratulatory slap on the back. Im every human being who ever lived? Or who will ever live, yes. Im Abraham Lincoln? And youre John Wilkes Booth, too, I added. Im Hitler? You said, appalled. And youre the millions he killed. Im Jesus? And youre everyone who followed him. You fell silent. Every time you victimized someone, I said, you were victimizing yourself. Every act of kindness youve done, youve done to yourself. Every happy and sad moment ever experienced by any human was, or will be, experienced by you. You thought for a long time. Why? You asked me. Why do all this? Because someday, you will become like me. Because thats what you are. Youre one of my kind. Youre my child. Whoa, you said, incredulous. You mean Im a god? No. Not yet. Youre a fetus. Youre still growing. Once youve lived every human life throughout all time, you will have grown enough to be born. So the whole universe, you said, its just  An egg. I answered. Now its time for you to move on to your next life. And I sent you on your way.

(just kidding, bitch, my process is simply SLOW -- DELICATE -- MYSTERIOUS ...even to myself... ). i dyed a few (two) things that didnât turn out *exactly* how i envisioned, and pissed my roommate off in the process; staining her brand-new fluffy yellow towels with splotches of hot pink. realizing that textile art is heavily involved, messy, and perhaps not a very roommate-friendly activity, i shoved everything into storage bins and moved onto sewing. i attempted to make a pair of quilted shorts, but banished my sewing machine to storage, too, after realizing i'd spent hours sewing something completely backwards. all that to say, i recently pulled out and reassessed the materials i collected; an activity which reawakened my latent interest. naturally, i havenât actually MADE anything yet, but still wanted to share some of the resources iâve come across. maybe i like researching and collecting art materials more than i do actually making art; maybe iâm just afraid of Doing The Hard Part . whatever, just, like, sue me, or whatever... maybe you should't really take resource recommendations from someone who hasn't actually tested said processes. regardless, for anyone interested, these are a few of the sources i plan to reference whenever i do get around to making something: Paula Burchâs website contains a wealth of no-frills dye tutorials and information. Bonus points for being a true HTML blog. Started in 1998, Pburch's site remains a goldmine. Ann Johnstonâs Color By Accident , (free PDF available here .) Ordered this per Paula Burchâs recommendation. Itâs like a cookbook for colors. Flipping through it, Iâm realizing low-water immersion dyeing is the look Iâm going for, as opposed to straight-up tie-dye. Also - Ann Johnston's website appears to contain many helpful resources, alongside her portfolio - worth checking out. Dharma Trading Co. has a lot of helpful tutorials on their website as well. When I do get started, Iâll probably refer to this tub dyeing basics article. Dharma is one of the main suppliers for professional home dyers. ( Jacquard , too.) At the moment, I am poised to spend $19.20 on: 5lbs of dyerâs salt (very fine salt, for easy dissolution) Glauberâs salt (to add vibrancy to turquoise and dyes containing turquoise) Dharma Dyerâs detergent (to pre-wash and to catch loose dye molecules post-dye) 5lbs of soda ash i donât feel ready to press âcheck outâ for whatever reason. well, i know the reason, but thereâs no need to go into it here. (o.k., itâs because iâm waiting for a fire call, again, and i donât want to make an order and have my package sit on my doorstep for weeks and potentially be stolen. i would ask [G] to come over and take it inside, but she is aware that i am very broke and i am embarrassed at the prospect of her seeing that i have ordered some potentially unnecessary materials. but, also, what if i get so, so good at this, and in five or ten years, i am accepted to attend an artist residency somewhere in the European countryside. none of this will matter then. maybe i should just press âcheck out.â maybe this is exactly how i accrued the debt which now plagues me so. either way, it's completely ridiculous of me to worry about this when i must admit i ordered some sewing supplies today anyway. waistband elastic, shirring elastic, sage-green paracord, and sage-green cord stoppers. whatever, anyway, this is why i said i didnât need to go into it. it's my life! my weird little life. i promise you with my entire soul that i will make something gorgeous one day. or soon. anyway.) I also ordered The Surface Designerâs Handbook: Dyeing, Printing, Painting, and Creating Resists on Fabric . Iâm preparing myself to be my siblingâs childrenâs strange-and-vibrant artist auntie. must make the art, then. I would like to begin looking into contemporary textile artists, because I know thereâs got to be lots of people with, like, 900 instagram followers making some insane shit. better yet, i'd like to find some artist's blogs. And me? When I feel into it, I know I would have my artistic world be mossy, rich with greens and browns; and oceanic, full of teals and seafoams and grays. I like stones and rain and sun-dappled ground. I love reading other people's music journalism so I'm excited to participate again. written November 2025 ♣dup step♣ ...A New Generation of Artists Is Reinvigorating Dubstep: Oli Warwick Spending the morning (early afternoon...) going through this recently published nu-dubstep guide. Warwick's compilation here appeals to me as a personal sonic nucleus - it's exactly what I mean when I say I love dubstep , but not necessarily, like, brostep/EDM or American ** wookstep **, which is increasingly popular here in the PNW and regionally seems to be what comes to mind when hearing the term "dubstep". "...in the scene surrounding artists like Koden or Masters and their label, Bait , thereâs an ever-growing clutch of artists taking cues from the more expansive era of the latter half of the decade, when dubstep started to cross-pollinate with other genres, especially techno." Dubstep's weighty, moody pallette pairs beautifully with skittery, hypermobile rhythms assimilated from techno and adjacent genres. This particular style of dubstep has fully captivated me in the last year or so, after coming across artists like Beatrice M., CarrÃ©, Andrae Durden, and others represented within. My next read will be this Beatrice M. interview, as mentioned in the guide. Illustration credit: Natalia Pawlak. written September 2025 Got Me Down [MR008] by Slacker everything on this label fucks... ♣kyoko okazaki♣ Presently nestling into an algorithmic burrow whose warm walls proffer artistic explorations exciting enough to patch internal holes of interest; dynamited open and left empty by a middle-schoolerâs undying Nana obsession. Iâve never been much of an anime/manga buff; rather, I find that choice examples of the artform find their way to me on occasion, setting off a quick, comforting phase until Iâm healed enough to venture back into the world of mainstream media. Last yearâs moment found me blissfully watching Paradise Kiss for the first time, and then attempting to rewatch/read Nana - which *actually* became too painful to finish, and thus turned me off anime for the rest of the year. That being said, I'm getting off-topic. What I came here to write about: Kyoko Okazaki Iâm very picky about the manga I read - it usually has to have Nanaâs scuzzy, fashionable qualities; it has to be centered around women and it gets bonus points if itâs at least a little nasty. Having a bit too much free time at the moment allowed me to blow through both Okazakiâs Pink and Helter Skelter in the last few days. Pink was an immersive read which let me sink into a favorite daydream - hardwerking grl in Japan experiences weird love - unfamiliar with Okazakiâs style, the ending left me staring at the wall. Helter Skelter - which I recognize has a great deal of popularity; Iâve had the movie on my watchlist for ages but had no idea it originated from a manga - was another excellent read, less daydream-immersive but equally intriguing. It made me think of The Substance - I wonder if thereâs an influence there. In a weird way, it left me feeling happy with my good old natural face; and slightly more comfortable with the idea of aging. I canât remember the exact quote, but in one of the stories, there was a line that went vaguely like: getting older is so excitingâ¦ itâs a new experience. I have spent so long making new experiences and memories to forget for the first time. I like stories that have playful, sexy, nonchalant characters who remind me that I can experience life a bit differently. Iâm probably going to end up reading all of Okazakiâs work now. The next one I have pulled up is Rock: A Club Kids Story . Looking up artists thematically similar to Ai Yazawa and Kyoko Okazaki brought up Anno Moyocco and Erica Sakurazawa, who I might look into later. It also reminded me to look deeper into Aya Takano - a cursory search brought up the âsuperflatâ art movement, another avenue to explore. Lastly, I remembered to look up Itsuko Ayano, but it seems like itâs maybe hard to find out things about her, as most links lead back to Anne Heroâs store, which is where I learned of her art in the first place. Oh, also, the Okazaki rabbithole led me over to the art of Aquirax Uno/Uno Akira, who seems to be a prolific, inimitable artist with a spellbinding body of work requiring its own dedicated rabbithole. Along the way, I also found two blog pages which looked interesting: Love Letter: Falling in Love With Itsuko Ayano and Japanese Fashion Archives . I havenât deeply explored any of the above-listed references, but figured Iâd leave them here in case anybody feels inclined to pick up where Iâve left off. Thereâs so much out there, and Iâll probably be shooting off in another direction by tomorrow â¦ man, all of this makes me want to start drawing again. Anyway, Kyoko Okazaki. Exciting, dreamy, gross, sexy. Weird. Cool. Also, I want to add a guestbook/chatlog to the homepage, bc NGL I really want somebody to say hello. :) 10/21/25: SHE'S UP!!... Okay, as expected, it took a little while to upload the site, and there were things I needed to fix. For one: file structure. When I initially uploaded to Neocities, *everything* was messed up, b/c Neocities didn't preserve my folders/structure, and this messed up all my file paths. I thusly learned about relative vs. absolute file paths and had to go back in and change ~all~ my filepaths to relative. I needed to reorganize all my folders anyway, so it was good to get it done. I think it all works now, except apparently you need to be a Neocities Supporter to upload a circular favicon? Sure, whatever. I spent a long time this morning trying to follow this tutorial about using Github to sync all changes from VSCode into Neocities, basically updating your site in real-time; but the thing is I'm not * that * nerdy YET. I went on a wild ride of installing homebrew, fucking something up with the filepath of my terminal shell, and somehow being able to fix it?? NGL, fixing it felt SO good. And also reminded me that I prob shouldn't be fucking around in Terminal as someone who literally does not know what they are doing. But I FIXED ITTTTTTTTTTTTT. I'm feeling like this Ninajirachi song :P Anyway, after spending hours trying to figure out the github thing, I realized (again) that if I wait to learn how to use command line and all this shit i do not understand, the site will nevvvverrrr getttt uploooadddedddd. So I'm gonna add it into my list of things I'm trying to learn (oh how I wish I could get paid to learn the things I want, lmao, like I should perhaps rlly be figuring out a career path instead but I'm so GENUINELY interested in all these other things!). /// Anyway, yeah I got nearly all the way through the github tutorial, managed to link vscodium with github and install git, and it synced one (1) file to baby's first ~repository~ and then gave me an error message that I am not yet able to comprehend. At this point, I just decided to suck it up and manually recreate all my folders in the Neocities editor. For now my plan is to just manually copy paste new changes from vscodium into neocities. But I'm really happy that this whole project has given me tangible reasons to learn new things, rather than just the nebulous "maybe i'll learn to code...". Code what? and why? Anyway, I guess the site is public now. Scarrrrrreeeeee. Fun. I promised myself to do it before October finished, so that's n i c e. 10/20/25: it's time... ite i think she ready to come out of my computer. i don't know how to make the bandcamp iframes responsive and that's drivng me nuts tho. however, there be no room in my ping-pong brain to figure it out at the moment. i'm comfortable with the way the site navigates, for now. i want to change up the entire formatting of the "recommendations" section already, but I can do that later. this is a blog and a music cache at its core: everything else is extraneous. i'm anticipating perhaps some weirdness in the process of uploading the site to neocities and figure i might as well just get her out there before I go too far with building something that has a lot of mistakes/incompatibilities. the idealist side of me wanted to make this like INSANELY cool with custom graphics and all - except wait I took and edited p much everything here so that's custom! - and I spent all day yesterday trying to *aquire* certain photo editing applications, to which end i was eventually SUCCESSFUL, thanks to a certain discord. i then tried to follow some youtube tutorials for said apps and realized why people go to school for graphic design. and then i realized if i wait to publish my site until after i've learned graphic design, it's just not gonna happen. so we're just gonna slam her on out there today, i think. oh, also, i ended up deleting the Humantooth-inspired monthly collages from the homepage because waiting to get myself to figure out how to format and write them was getting silly. there are things i want to blog about but mostly i just want to get the site up. i have to just let it evolve over time. 10/25: STILL working on homepage... I feel like the site is nearly presentable enough to publish. I knew this process would spur on emotional/personal growth of sorts. I'm challenging myself to be okay with imperfection for the sake of "finishing". Last night, I heard someone in a video say "perfection is the enemy of completion." Tru... This is the kind of hobby I could easily see myself abandoning when experiencing difficulty, or bullying myself out of (it's really self-indulgent...), so I'm proud that I've kept up with it. I'm excited about the way it's pushing me to learn things about design; to do more art so I have things to put on here, and especially the way it's got me writing. It almost feels silly to do art just for the sake of a blog, but at this point, I'll take anything that makes me create. I think the plan right now is to just get the homepage ready, then pick out where I'm actually going to host the site. I know neocities has some issues r/e AI trawling, which I'm not a fan of; but at the same time, I want my site to be somewhat discoverable - I feel like if I go straight to my own domain then nobody will ever find it. I'd love for this to be a way to connect with like-minded websrfrss. It's probably gonna be a lot of screaming into the void, too, but, whatever. at least i'm DOING something. anyway, i'll probably host on neocities and then move domains later when I better understand how this all works. I'm still very, very new. So yeah. "Finish" homepage → upload site to Neocities → continue working on other pages, like media recs, my own music/demos page (rabbitholeradio...), etc → just generally learning more about designing/coding websites and probably redoing everything in the process. I have these monthly collage things on the homepage, directly inspired by Humantooth's homepage, that I'm trying to figure out, too. Homepage homage. I'm really, really into Humantooth's blog, by the way. Check them out. 09/25: Trying to design homepage... Trying to build homepage and get site into a publishable state. I originally wasn't planning on making a myspace-style page like this, but I realised I didn't like the sitemap being the first page after entering the site. I still have all my little sections divvied up into separate webpages, but now I'm thinking about consolidating some of them so there's less clicking around. I want to fill this page up in a way that's cohesive and not too cluttered. The homepage is turning out to be the hardest design so far. It's difficult to decide where to put everything! 08/25: Learning rudimentary html/css/js... Learning rudimentary html/css/js. A ton of open tabs: freecodecamp projects, Kevin Powell videos, and poking around in other people's code. Organizing personal notes/resources in Milanote , and doodling ideas and layouts in a physical notebook. Lots of sitting cross-legged with my laptop. Feeling the need to have the site's first iteration mostly complete before publishing, yet really eager to start participating. This is the kind of project that's never really complete, right? Working on fleshing out basic templates+design choices for each page, trying to decide on the site's flow. Filling in actual content where I can. Pages for things like reviews are their own beasts + will take way more time to flesh out. Every day I learn something new that makes me want to go back and redesign everything. I'm feeling really proud of/excited about how quickly it's coming together, though; since I started this endeavor with absolutely zero know-how.

Як часц русинского народу бешедую на (панонским) руским язику . Руснаци на териториї нєшкайшей Сербиї жию вецей як 260 роки. У нашей богатей традициї 17. януар 1751. рок остал зазначени як окремни датум. Того дня Франц Йозеф де Редл, совитнїк царици Мариї Терезиї и администратор Кральовско-державного Бачкого дистрикту у Зомборе подписал перши урядови документ - Контракт о насельованю 200 руских грекокатолїцких фамелийох на тедишню пустару Вельки Керестур. Прешов познати як центер православя у Словацкей. Саскачеванске дружтво рускей култури "Русин" основане у Саскатунє, Саскачеван, Канада 2006. року. Снователє о. Янко Колошняї и Любомир Медєши. Дружтво орґанизує рочни Руски пикник и Дзециньски камп Studia Ruthenica то науково-фахови часопис (рочнїк) хтори видава Дружтво за руски язик, литературу и културу зоз шедзиском у Новим Садзе. Часопис почал виходзиц 1975. року под першобутну назву Творчосц. У часопису ше обявює науково роботи и фахово прилоги з обласци русинистики. Der Hauptort ist Bellinzona . Das Tessin macht den grössten Teil der italienischen Schweiz (Svizzera italiana) aus. Es liegt auf der südlichen Seite des Alpenhauptkamms und ist weitgehend von Italien umgeben; nur im Norden und Nordosten grenzt es an die Schweizer Kantone Graubünden , Wallis und Uri . Herzlich willkommen in der zentralen Anlaufstelle des Kantons Tessin in der Wikipedia. Wir freuen uns über Fragen und Anregungen auf der Diskussionsseite und selbstverständlich über deine Mitarbeit . Sie hat etwa 2,8 Millionen Einwohner (31. Dezember 2025) und ist eine der am dichtesten besiedelten städtischen Agglomerationen Europas. Karte der Region Stuttgart Diese Seite soll den Einstieg in die Artikel rund um die Region Stuttgart erleichtern. Geschichte, Geographie und andere Bereiche bieten einen ersten Überblick über die Menschen in der Region Stuttgart. Es soll dem Interessierten einen Überblick geben und Anregungen stiften. Do you use Wikidata in Wikimedia sibling projects? Tell us about your experiences [ edit source ] Note: Apologies for cross-posting and sending in English. Hello, the Wikidata for Wikimedia Projects team at Wikimedia Deutschland would like to hear about your experiences using Wikidata in the sibling projects. If you are interested in sharing your opinion and insights, please consider signing up for an interview with us in this Registration form . Currently, we are only able to conduct interviews in English. The front page of the form has more details about what the conversation will be like, including how we would compensate you for your time. For more information, visit our project issue page where you can also share your experiences in written form, without an interview. We look forward to speaking with you, Danny Benjafield (WMDE) ( talk ) 08:53, 5 January 2024 (UTC) Reusing references: Can we look over your shoulder? [ edit source ] Apologies for writing in English. The Technical Wishes team at Wikimedia Deutschland is planning to make reusing references easier . For our research, we are looking for wiki contributors willing to show us how they are interacting with references. The format will be a 1-hour video call, where you would share your screen. More information here . Interviews can be conducted in English, German or Dutch. Compensation is available . Sessions will be held in January and February. Sign up here if you are interested. Please note that we probably won’t be able to have sessions with everyone who is interested. Our UX researcher will try to create a good balance of wiki contributors, e.g. in terms of wiki experience, tech experience, editing preferences, gender, disability and more. If you’re a fit, she will reach out to you to schedule an appointment. We’re looking forward to seeing you, Thereza Mengs (WMDE) Feminism and Folklore 2024 [ edit source ] Latest comment: 2 years ago 1 comment 1 person in discussion Please help translate to your language Dear Wiki Community, You are humbly invited to organize the Feminism and Folklore 2024 writing competition from February 1, 2023, to March 31, 2023 on your local Wikipedia. This year, Feminism and Folklore will focus on feminism, women's issues, and gender-focused topics for the project, with a Wiki Loves Folklore gender gap focus and a folk culture theme on Wikipedia. You can help Wikipedia's coverage of folklore from your area by writing or improving articles about things like folk festivals, folk dances, folk music, women and queer folklore figures, folk game athletes, women in mythology, women warriors in folklore, witches and witch hunting, fairy tales, and more. Users can help create new articles, expand or translate from a generated list of suggested articles. Organisers are requested to work on the following action items to sign up their communities for the project: Create a page for the contest on the local wiki. Set up a campaign on CampWiz tool. Create the local list and mention the timeline and local and international prizes. Request local admins for site notice. Link the local page and the CampWiz link on the meta project page . This year, the Wiki Loves Folklore Tech Team has introduced two new tools to enhance support for the campaign. These tools include the Article List Generator by Topic and CampWiz . The Article List Generator by Topic enables users to identify articles on the English Wikipedia that are not present in their native language Wikipedia. Users can customize their selection criteria, and the tool will present a table showcasing the missing articles along with suggested titles. Additionally, users have the option to download the list in both CSV and wikitable formats. Notably, the CampWiz tool will be employed for the project for the first time, empowering users to effectively host the project with a jury. Both tools are now available for use in the campaign. Click here to access these tools Learn more about the contest and prizes on our project page . Feel free to contact us on our meta talk page or by email us if you need any assistance. We look forward to your immense coordination. Thank you and Best wishes, Feminism and Folklore 2024 International Team Stay connected -- MediaWiki message delivery ( talk ) 07:26, 18 Janueri 2024 (UTC) Reply Wiki Loves Folklore is back! [ edit source ] Latest comment: 2 years ago 1 comment 1 person in discussion Please help translate to your language Dear Wiki Community, You are humbly invited to participate in the Wiki Loves Folklore 2024 an international photography contest organized on Wikimedia Commons to document folklore and intangible cultural heritage from different regions, including, folk creative activities and many more. It is held every year from the 1st till the 31st of March. You can help in enriching the folklore documentation on Commons from your region by taking photos, audios, videos, and submitting them in this commons contest. You can also organize a local contest in your country and support us in translating the project pages to help us spread the word in your native language. Please help translate to your language Hello everyone, After carefully tallying both individual and affiliate votes, the Charter Electoral Commission is pleased to announce the final results of the Wikimedia Movement Charter voting. As communicated by the Charter Electoral Commission, we reached the quorum for both Affiliate and individual votes by the time the vote closed on July 9, 23:59 UTC . We thank all 2,451 individuals and 129 Affiliate representatives who voted in the ratification process. Your votes and comments are invaluable for the future steps in Movement Strategy. The final results of the Wikimedia Movement Charter ratification voting held between 25 June and 9 July 2024 are as follows: Individual vote: Out of 2,451 individuals who voted as of July 9 23:59 (UTC), 2,446 have been accepted as valid votes. Among these, 1,710 voted “yes”; 623 voted “no”; and 113 selected “–” (neutral). Because the neutral votes don’t count towards the total number of votes cast, 73.30% voted to approve the Charter (1710/2333), while 26.70% voted to reject the Charter (623/2333). Affiliates vote: Out of 129 Affiliates designated voters who voted as of July 9 23:59 (UTC), 129 votes are confirmed as valid votes. Among these, 93 voted “yes”; 18 voted “no”; and 18 selected “–” (neutral). Because the neutral votes don’t count towards the total number of votes cast, 83.78% voted to approve the Charter (93/111), while 16.22% voted to reject the Charter (18/111). Board of Trustees of the Wikimedia Foundation: The Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees voted not to ratify the proposed Charter during their special Board meeting on July 8, 2024. The Chair of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees, Nataliia Tymkiv, shared the result of the vote, the resolution, meeting minutes and proposed next steps . With this, the Wikimedia Movement Charter in its current revision is not ratified . We thank you for your participation in this important moment in our movement’s governance.
